{{Quote|An assault rifle sporting caseless ammunition and a top-mounted magazine. An electrical firing mechanism releases the rounds in rapid succession upon firing. Equipped with an underslung shotgun for added versatility.|Armory Description}}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Primary Weapon|Primary Assault Rifle]] equipped with an underslung shotgun.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Ironclad Democracy Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|AR-11 Arbitrator}}

== Attachments Table ==
{{Attachments Table|Arbitrator}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Despite having a lower damage of 70 compared to most [[Weapons#Assault_Rifle-0|assault rifles]], the Arbitrator makes up for this with a high rate of fire and unique underslung shotgun.
** The Arbitrator has the highest RPM out of all assault rifles, giving it considerable DPS, but also making it harder to control.
** After the first few rounds, the Arbitrator develops a significant horizontal spread pattern, making continued automatic fire quite hard to control.
*** This can be alleviated by using the burst function, limiting the weapon to fire 3 round bursts every time the trigger is held.
* The Arbitrator is '''best used when firing in burst mode''', as this reduces recoil and conserves ammunition without restricting firepower, due to the significant rate of fire. 
** One full burst anywhere on the body is often enough to kill most light enemies (such as [[Trooper]]s, [[Hunter]]s, and [[Voteless]]).
** Firing in bursts also allows for more accurate fire, particularly against small enemy weak spots such as [[Devastator]] heads.
* The underslung shotgun's high damage and {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetrating rounds make the Arbitrator effective against enemies that are especially deadly in close quarters (such as [[Alpha Commander]]s, [[Berserker]]s, and [[Overseer]]s).
** However, the shotgun has a low stagger force, meaning that most enemies will not be slowed or staggered after being hit, which can be problematic in close quarters.
*** When facing high-health enemies, Helldivers are advised to engage at a distance with 4mm shots to weaken them before engaging in close-quarters with the shotgun.
** The spread of shot also allows for forgiving aim against chaff enemies (such as [[Bile Spitter]]s, [[Scavenger]]s, and [[Pouncer]]s).
* The Arbitrator has a low ergonomics value (30 compared to the [[AR-23 Liberator]]'s 65), meaning that it is slower to move around while aiming.
** This can be alleviated by wearing armor with the {{Passive|Peak Physique}} passive, which adds +30 to all weapons' ergonomics value.
* As a Rounds Reload weapon, the underslung shotgun is reloaded one shell at a time. This makes impossible to waste ammo while reloading.
* The Arbitrator benefits from being able to quickly switch between its rifle and shotgun to adapt to different situations. Helldivers are advised to set the keybind to "Quick Weapon Wheel: Left" to easily swap between the weapon's two modes without needing to engage the weapon wheel.

== Trivia ==
* The AR-11 Arbitrator is likely based on the [[wp:Heckler & Koch G11| H&K G11]] rifle, a prototype rifle designed to fire caseless ammunition.
** This is supported by using the same numeric designation as well as similar ammunition (4mm caseless in-game vs. varying sizes of 4mm caseless in real life).
** However, the AR-11 lacks both the high surplus magazine capacity (due to rounds weighing half that of 5.56x45mm) & iconic "hyperburst", both of which were prominent features of the G11.
*** Additionally, the AR-11 states a "electrical firing mechanism," whereas the G11 is entirely mechanical.
* The front end of the weapon may be more in reference to the M-41A Pulse Rifle from the [[wp:Alien (franchise)|Alien franchise]], featuring a perforated heat-shield and underslung shotgun (albeit portrayed as a grenade launcher in the Alien franchise).
* The underslung shotgun included with this weapon is likely based on the [[wp:Knight%27s_Armament_Company_Masterkey|KAC Masterkey]]. The attachment was designed to be used as a breaching device, shooting off door hinges or breaking open locks, hence the name "Masterkey."

The '''AR-23 Liberator''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Assault Rifle]], available for all Helldivers.

__FORCETOC__
== Procurement ==
The Liberator is available to all Helldivers upon completion of training.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data_Weapon|AR-23 LIBERATOR}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Liberator}}

== Tactical Information ==
*As the starter assault rifle, the Liberator is capable of engaging Democracy's enemies on any field of battle.
**Despite being starter equipment, the damage-per-second of the Liberator is very respectable, its recoil quite low, and the ammo capacity generous. It remains a competent choice even given more advanced options.
*The scope can be adjusted to fight at close to medium range, with options at 25m, 50m and 100m, allowing the [[Helldiver]] to place rounds precisely where needed.
*Its fire rate can be adjusted between Semi-/Fully-Automatic or Three-Round Burst. At short ranges, full-auto can quickly and easily overwhelm enemies with a storm of bullets, while at longer ranges burst or semi-auto firing can be used to precisely land rounds on distant enemies' weak spots.
*An under-barrel flashlight can be adjusted based on visibility conditions. In Auto mode, the flashlight turns on only when the weapon is aimed. It can also be turned always on or off.
*A laser pointer is activated when {{Tooltip|ADS|Aiming Down Sights}}, pointing to where rounds will land. This is also visible to teammates, making it a helpful feature aiding in hitting targets while also warning teammates if they would walk across your line of (friendly) fire.
*Beware that the weapon can only penetrate {{Armor|2|AP}} armor, meaning it will have a harder time engaging armored enemies such as [[Hive Guard]]s and [[Devastator]]s. These enemies must be dispatched by targeting their {{Armor|0|AP}} and {{Armor|1|AP}} body parts (the thorax and abdomen on Hive Guards, or the head, waist, and pelvis on Devastators). Be sure to consider a proper [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|secondary]] or [[Weapons#Support Weapons|support weapon]] to account for the Liberator's low armor penetration.

}}{{Quote|A compact version of the Liberator designed for increased viability in close quarters. Has an increased fire rate at the cost of higher spread.|Armory Description}}

The '''AR-23A Liberator Carbine''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Assault Rifle]], a carbine variant of the standard [[AR-23 Liberator|Liberator]], featuring a much faster fire rate at the cost of significantly increased recoil.

== Procurement ==
The Liberator Carbine is unlocked on the first page of the [[Viper Commandos Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Liberator Carbine}}

== Tactical Information ==
The key advantage that the Liberator Carbine has over the standard Liberator is its extremely high rate of fire. At 920 RPM, it can put over 40% more fire downrange in the same amount of time. This gives it a damage output comparable to the [[M-105 Stalwart]], a [[Weapons#Support_Weapons|Support Weapon]], provided the Helldiver can manage its high recoil and fast ammo consumption.
* The Liberator Carbine shines in mid to close range encounters, quickly dispatching of enemies before they can get into melee range. As such, it excels against the [[Terminids]], but struggles more against the [[Automatons]] or [[Illuminate]], who demand better accuracy and/or armor penetration.
** As it uses the same rounds as the default Liberator's, it has comparable bullet velocity and damage falloff values, giving it an edge over Shotguns or Submachine Guns at longer ranges.
** Though advertised through its woodland camouflage and associated [[Warbond]] to perform well in a [[Basic_Swamp|swamp]] or [[Volcanic_Jungle|jungle]] setting, the Liberator Carbine performs just as well, if not better, in the concrete jungle. [[Cities]] offer much more mid range encounters and are generally more predictable terrain-wise than the aforementioned biomes, giving Helldivers space to reload and fire from a safe distance.
** The [[Siege-Ready]] [[Armor Passives|Armor Passive]] pairs well with this weapon, as it not only provides more reserve ammo to burn through when needed, but also further lowers the Carbine's already fast reload speed relative to the Liberator.
* The drawback of the weapon's higher rate of fire is that it also creates a proportionally higher amount of recoil, making it harder to maintain aim at targets. This can be mitigated by crouching, laying prone, equipping an armor set that reduces recoil (such as [[Engineering Kit]] or [[Fortified]]), or by attaching a [[Vertical Foregrip]] and a [[Compensator]].
* Though it possesses a slightly faster reload than the traditional Liberator, it's important to be wary of when and where to reload the Liberator Carbine.
** Its high rate of fire and resultant recoil means running out of ammo faster and a higher likelihood of wasting bullets, even if both weapons carry the same combat load. This makes it easier to be caught with an empty magazine mid-combat. It's important to take advantage of its mid-range capabilities to dispatch of enemies before they can get close enough to deal damage. Be mindful of nearby enemies so that they do not get an opportunity to attack while reloading, and be ready to retreat to a safer position to reload if the situation calls for it.
** Be ready to call down a [[Resupply]] when needed or to look for [[Supplies#Ammo Box|Ammo Boxes]] at [[Minor Place of Interest|Minor Places of Interest]].
** Because it does not carry more magazines to compensate for its high rate of fire, each magazine becomes even more precious. While tactical reloading is still helpful to avoid running empty in the middle of a subsequent engagement, care should be taken to deplete a magazine as much as possible before discarding it.
* The selection of a reliable [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Weapon]] may matter more when using the Liberator Carbine, as it can become the fallback weapon more frequently than with other Primary Weapons. As such, weapons like the [[LAS-58 Talon]], [[P-4 Senator]], or [[P-19 Redeemer]] may be preferred over more utility-oriented secondaries like the [[GP-31 Grenade Pistol]] or [[P-11 Stim Pistol]].
* As a {{Armor|2|AP}} penetrating weapon, the Carbine shares all the drawbacks of the regular Liberator in that regard, requiring users to target weak points on enemies with {{Armor|3|AP}} armor sections.

The '''AR-23C Liberator Concussive''' is [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Assault Rifle]], a variant of the standard [[AR-23 Liberator|Liberator]] with a drum magazine and increased stagger power in exchange for a significantly reduced rate of fire.

== Procurement ==
The Liberator Concussive is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|AR-23C LIBERATOR CONCUSSIVE}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Liberator Concussive}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The primary advantage of the Liberator Concussive is that its concussive rounds inflict heavy stagger and knockback on enemies that it damages, allowing it to stop foes like [[Berserker]]s, [[Alpha Commander]]s, [[Stalker]]s and [[Overseer]]s cold in their tracks.
** Because enemies will remain staggered for as long as they are being hit by this weapon, they can be rendered completely helpless for teammates to dispatch.
** The stagger does not stack with itself, it only resets with each new round that hits the target. Thus, it is best to pace your shots and try to hit the target at a deliberate interval rather than to unload on it.
** Repeated impacts can push targets backward a considerable distance. This can be very useful not only for crowd control, but also for pushing enemies towards hazards such as burning ground, gas clouds and [[Exploding Barrels]].
* Another advantage of the Liberator Concussive is that it is equipped by default with a drum magazine, which has an increased capacity compared to the box magazines used by default in the standard Liberator. This allows it to maintain stagger-lock on foes for an extended period of time.
** The large ammo drum allows the Liberator Concussive to remain in action for longer periods of time. This can mean locking down an enemy for as long as the drum lasts, and remaining on station to support teammates without having to worry about reloading.
** Be mindful of the weapon's limited number of drums, and try to avoid tactical reloads when possible. Expend as much of the drum as possible before reloading.
* Unlike the standard Liberator, the Liberator Concussive does not have a burst fire mode, and is only equipped with a red dot sight by default. This means that it quickly loses accuracy at longer ranges, making the weapon more of a medium to close-range fighter.
* The primary drawback of the Liberator Concussive compared to the standard Liberator is its low damage output due to its greatly reduced firing rate.
** While each individual round does only slightly less damage than those of the standard Liberator, this is further compounded by its low firing rate, meaning that it has trouble killing even individual enemies. As such, the Liberator Concussive is especially poor at dealing with crowds, and serves more as an lockdown weapon that disables lone enemies that it is firing at and prevents them from retaliating.
** Its inability to quickly kill targets makes the Liberator Concussive function more like a "support primary," locking targets down in place so that teammates with real firepower can kill them while they are helpless.
* One quirk of the Liberator Concussive's rounds is that they inflict almost twice as much [[Damage#Enemy_Durability_&_Durable_Damage|durable damage]] as those fired by the standard Liberator. This can give it an edge when fighting lightly armored but highly durable enemies like [[Brood Commander]]s, [[Bile Spewer]]s and [[Stalker]]s.

The '''AR-23P Liberator Penetrator''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Assault Rifle]], a variant of the standard [[AR-23 Liberator|Liberator]] with increased armor-piercing capabilities. 

== Procurement ==
The Liberator Penetrator is unlocked on the 6th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|AR-23P LIBERATOR PENETRATOR}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Liberator Penetrator}}

== Tactical Information ==
* As a sidegrade to the standard Liberator, the Liberator Penetrator inflicts less damage per round, but possesses the ability to pierce {{Armor|3|AV}} armor. Its default scope is also more powerful, able to zoom at farther ranges.
** The increased armor penetration afforded by this weapon gives it better [[damage]] when fighting enemies protected by {{Armor|2|AV}} armor. Whereas the standard Liberator will inflict only 65% of its damage against {{Armor|2|AV}} armored targets (resulting in roughly 52 damage per round barring any durability factors), the Liberator Penetrator will deal its full damage, giving it a 15% damage advantage.
** The primary advantage granted by its ability to penetrate {{Armor|3|AV}} armor is that it is able to inflict damage to the body parts of enemies that the standard Liberator cannot. For example, the torso of all [[Devastator]] variants are immune to any damage from the standard Liberator, but can be damaged and defeated by the Liberator Penetrator.
* Be aware that against {{Armor|0|AV}} and {{Armor|1|AV}} enemies and body parts, the Liberator Penetrator is less effective than the standard Liberator, as its armor-piercing rounds inflict less base damage. 
** The increased base damage of the standard Liberator allows it to defeat most medium-sized enemies in fewer shots versus the Liberator Penetrator, such as [[Warrior]]s and [[Stalker]]s.
** Certain weak spots on various Automaton enemies are also {{Armor|0|AV}} or {{Armor|1|AV}}, meaning that with precise aim the standard Liberator can still come out on top, such as when targeting the heads or waists of [[Devastator]]s and [[Berserker]]s rather than their torsos.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Primary Weapon|Primary Assault Rifle]], equipped with a suppressor for silent takedowns, especially suited to [[Stealth]] playstyles.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|50}} 

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|AR-59 Suppressor}}

== Attachments Table ==
{{Attachments Table|Suppressor}}

== Tactical Information ==
* As a suppressed weapon, the Suppressor benefits from having a reduced detection presence compared to other weapons.
** Suppressed weapons have an audible range of 13 meters. Instead of immediately being aware of a Helldiver's position, enemies will instead become suspicious of the shots and start to investigate. Enemies can still be alerted after several rapid missed shots.
* Helldivers can use that advantage to eliminate their targets, such as [[Trooper]]s on objectives, without revealing their position. However, killing any unit in patrol will still alert the rest of the group, and the Helldiver will be engaged.
* It is recommended to target smaller [[Automaton]] units such as [[Trooper]]s, [[MG Raider]]s, and [[Commissar]]s first, as they are capable of calling in reinforcements.
** When targeting these units, it is recommended to aim for the head to kill them in a single shot without giving them a chance to call reinforcements.

The '''AR-61 Tenderizer''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Assault Rifle]] that fires {{Armor|2|AP}}-armor penetrating high-caliber rounds. It boasts the highest damage per round in its class.

==Procurement==
The Tenderizer is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Polar Patriots Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|AR-61 TENDERIZER}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Tenderizer}}

==Tactical Information==
* A key feature of the Tenderizer are its high caliber rounds that inflict the most damage per shot of any Assault Rifle in the game. The Tenderizer is able to kill most small targets in only two or three shots, and makes quick work of larger unarmored targets with rapid fire.
** The weapon can be switched to 850 rpm via Weapon Wheel for higher damage output.
* In exchange for its greater damage output, the Tenderizer has a smaller magazine than the [[AR-23 Liberator]] series assault rifles, sporting a 35-round magazine.
** To avoid depleting the magazine too quickly the rifle can be set to burst or semi-automatic firing mode. Take advantage of the high damage rounds to dispatch foes in as few shots as possible, aiming for unarmored weak points.
** More frequent reloads require anticipatory positioning to avoid being caught with an empty magazine amidst a group of enemies.
** Presumably for balance reasons, extended and drum magazines may not be added to the Tenderizer using the [[Attachments]] system.
* The reduced combat load of ammo may be ameliorated by equipping armor with the Siege-Ready [[Armor Passives|Armor Passive]]. The [[B-1 Supply Pack|Supply Pack]] may also be taken to augment ammo capacity.
* The Tenderizer's most direct competitor is the [[BR-14 Adjudicator|Adjudicator]], which sports {{Armor|3|AP}}-armor penetrating rounds in exchange for less damage per round, much higher vertical recoil, and a lower fire rate.
** While the [[BR-14 Adjudicator|Adjudicator]]'s magazine is smaller, it carries 8 mags instead of 7, meaning its combat load is only 5 rounds less than the Tenderizer.
*A player using the Tenderizer may find themselves having to re-position to target an enemy's {{Armor|0|AP}} or {{Armor|1|AP}} body parts, such as circumventing a [[Hive Guard]]'s {{Armor|3|AP}} plated head, or circling around a [[Scout Strider]] to attack its pilot rather than targeting its {{Armor|3|AP}} armor legs.

==Trivia==
*The Tenderizer released with an unusual green-and-tan colour scheme despite being portrayed with a black body in the reveal trailer, though this was later fixed in Patch 01.000.304.
*The weapon's appearance and (hidden) '[https://starshiptroopers.fandom.com/wiki/John_Rico_(film) Rico]' ammo type suggest it might be a reference to the [https://starshiptroopers.fandom.com/wiki/Morita_Assault_Rifle Morita Assault Rifle] from [[wikipedia:en:Starship Troopers|Starship Troopers]], one of the primary inspirations for the Helldivers franchise. 
*When fired on 850 rpm in burst mode, the Tenderizer bears a startling resemblance to the [https://www.halopedia.org/BR55_battle_rifle BR-55 Battle Rifle] from Halo,  both visually and audibly.

Versatile, but heavy to wield.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Primary Weapon|Primary Assault Rifle]] equipped with an underbarrel grenade launcher. == Procurement == The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Python Commandos Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|AR/GL-21 One-Two}} ==Attachments Table== {{Attachments Table|One-Two}} ==Tactical Information== * The AR/GL-21 One-Two's underbarrel grenade launcher allows for greater loadout versatility, alleviating the need to bring a dedicated [[Equipment Traits#Explosive|explosive weapon/throwable]] to destroy certain [[:Category:Structures|enemy structures and spawners]]. ** The underbarrel grenade launcher is statistically identical to the [[GP-31 Grenade Pistol]]. ** The explosive damage and radius of the grenades allows the grenade launcher to eliminate multiple light enemies with a single shot, or inflict significant damage to large body parts such as the butt of [[Bile Spewer]]s. *** However, this should be done sparingly, as the grenade launcher's ammo is limited to three spare rounds, which are typically better used for destroying enemy spawners. * Helldivers are advised to not fire the grenade launcher at very close range, as the fuse has a range safety that prevents it from detonating too close from the point of fire. If the grenade hits an enemy at point-blank range, it will simply bounce off and ricochet, exploding far from its intended target, potentially even killing the Helldiver who fired it. * Because of its very slow initial velocity and high drag factor, it can be difficult to land precise shots at long distances with the grenade launcher, especially against [[Automaton Fabricator]]s, since gravity must be accounted for. Helldivers are advised to regularly practice the use of the grenade launcher to accurately predict its trajectory. ** Other weapons such as the [[GL-21 Grenade Launcher]], [[GL-28 Belt-Fed Grenade Launcher]], and [[GL-52 De-Escalator]] can also be used to practice, as all three share the same physical attributes and trajectories with the AR/GL-21 One-Two's underbarrel grenade launcher. * The One-Two has a low ergonomics value (30 compared to the [[AR-23 Liberator|AR-23 Liberator's]] 65), meaning that it is slower to move around while aiming. ** This can be alleviated by wearing armor with the {{Passive|Peak Physique}} passive, which adds +30 to all weapons' ergonomics value. * With a 40 round magazine and six spare magazines, the One-Two has a poor ammo economy (280 rounds compared to the Liberator's 405). Helldivers are advised to practice good precision and rapid, semi-automatic fire (rather than full-auto), in order to maximize each round. ** The One-Two has only five reserve grenades, compared to the GP-31 Grenade Pistol which carries six reserves. * The One-Two benefits from being able to quickly switch between its rifle and grenade launcher to adapt to different situations. Helldivers are advised to set the keybind to "Quick Weapon Wheel: Left" to easily swap between the weapon's two modes without needing to engage the weapon wheel. == Media == AR-GL-21 One-Two, Weapon Wheel.png|Weapon Wheel AR-GL-21_One-Two,_Aiming,_Third-Person_.png|Aiming, Third-Person AR-GL-21_One-Two,_40mm_mode,_Aiming,_Third-Person.png|Aiming, 40mm mode, Third-Person AR-GL-21_One-Two,_Ditto,_First-Person_(25m).png|Aiming, First-Person (25m) AR-GL-21_One-Two,_Ditto,_First-Person_(50m).png|Aiming, First-Person (50m) AR-GL-21_One-Two,_Ditto,_First-Person_(100m).png|Aiming, First-Person (100m) File:GL-21 One-Two 3rd Reloads.gif|Reloading, Third-Person (full and partial) File:GL-21 One-Two 1st Reloads.gif|Reloading, First-Person (full and partial) File:GL-21 One-Two 40mm 3rd Reloads.gif|Reloading 40mm Grenade, Third-Person File:GL-21 One-Two 40mm 1st Reloads.gif|Reloading 40mm Grenade, First-Person == Trivia == * The AR/GL-21 One-Two's inclusion is a potential reference to the gun used by Arnold Swarzenegger in the 1987 film ''[[wikipedia:Predator (film)|Predator]]'', hence its inclusion in the [[Python_Commandos_Premium_Warbond|Python Commandos Warbond]] which draws several other ''Predator'' references. {{Quote|An accurate, armor-penetrating rifle, the BR-14 Adjudicator delivers righteous judgement to medium-sized enemies, though its restrictive magazine limits its effectiveness against large groups.|Armory Description}}

The '''BR-14 Adjudicator''' is a [[Weapons#Assault_Rifle-0|Primary Assault Rifle]]. It fires {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetrating rounds with high damage, but has a restricted magazine size and moderate recoil.

== Procurement ==
The Adjudicator is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Democratic Detonation Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|BR-14 ADJUDICATOR}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Adjudicator}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Compared to others in its weapon class, the Adjudicator's advantages are its high damage per round and ability to penetrate {{Armor|3|AP}} armor. 
** The Adjudicator can be a very reliable weapon for dealing with armored foes. It can dispatch [[Brood Commander]]s, [[Hive Guard]]s, [[Reinforced Scout Strider]]s and [[Devastator]]s even when aiming directly at their {{Armor|3|AP}} armor portions.
* The Adjudicator's primary drawback is its lower magazine capacity and higher recoil per shot, making it harder to put multiple rounds on the same target in quick succession.
** Because of this, Helldivers are advised to employ tap-firing to conserve ammo and control recoil.
** While recoil may be reduced with the compensator and vertical foregrip, the Adjudicator cannot have extended or drum magazines added using the [[Attachments]] system. This is presumably for balance reasons.
** The ammo capacity is 1/3 less than the [[AR-23P Liberator Penetrator]] (which does nearly 1/3 less damage-per round in exchange). The Adjudicator combat load is also only five rounds less than the [[AR-61 Tenderizer]] (another high-damage-per-round AR with no magazine options).
* Its heavy recoil can also be diminished by equipping armor with the [[Engineering Kit]] or [[Fortified]] [[Armor Passives]]. Additionally, a crouched or prone stance further assists with keeping rounds on target.
* Meanwhile, the reduced combat load of ammo may be ameliorated by equipping armor with the [[Siege-Ready]] [[Armor Passives|Armor Passive]]. The [[B-1 Supply Pack]] may also be taken to augment ammo capacity.

== Trivia ==
* Because the Adjudicator uses a full-power cartridge instead of an intermediate cartridge (8x60mm vs the [[AR-23 Liberator]]'s 5x50mm), it is considered a [[WP:Battle rifle|battle rifle]] rather than an assault rifle, also reflected in its designation of '''BR''' instead of '''AR'''. 
* The design is loosely based off of the [[wikipedia:FN_FAL|FN Fal]] and American [[wikipedia:M14_rifle|M14 Rifle]], even noting the designation of "BR-14".
* Interestingly, despite it sharing the same round dimensions and round type as the [[MG-43 Machine Gun]] (8x60mm FMJ), the Adjudicator does 5 more damage.

Gravity must be accounted for when aiming.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Explosive]] weapon. It fires explosive-tipped crossbow bolts that deal damage in an area. == Procurement == The Exploding Crossbow is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Democratic Detonation Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|80}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|CB-9 EXPLODING CROSSBOW}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Exploding Crossbow}} == Tactical Information == * The primary use of the Exploding Crossbow is to inflict significant damage to a single target while also dealing explosive damage in a radius around the impact point. This makes it a flexible weapon that can deal heavy damage to a single target or significant splash damage in an area. ** The explosive bolts fired by this weapon have a relatively slow travel speed and are greatly affected by gravity, making it difficult to use against distant targets. Practice is required to get accustomed to its arc. ** Because it is a Primary Weapon with a very low rate of fire and a small magazine, equipping the Exploding Crossbow means that the wielder must rely on the Secondary or Support Weapon in the event that a rapid fire option is required. Weapons like the [[P-19 Redeemer]] or [[M-105 Stalwart]] can fill this role. * The exploding bolts fired by the Exploding Crossbow are highly flexible, capable of dealing with many battlefield threats. ** The crossbow bolt itself inflicts high damage, and when combined with the subsequent explosion can deal significant damage to targets with light armor. As such, the weapon excels at destroying lone enemies not protected by medium armor or stronger. ** The exploding tips give the weapon a damage profile similar to the [[G-16 Impact]] grenade even if it does not directly impact a target. As such, it can be aimed into clusters of enemies to inflict powerful splash damage to multiple targets. *** Unlike other explosives detonation on impact, the crossbow bolts can "skip / slide" over flat surfaces if they're not making contact at a perpendicular angle. In practice, undershooting a crowd on the same level can leave a bolt sliding past all targets and exploding too far behind them. * The Exploding Crossbow possesses several traits that make it a strong utility weapon. ** Although it fires crossbow bolts, it is not a silenced weapon. Enemies within a 30-meter radius will detect the sound and go on alert. ** It is also the only primary weapon which isn't a Submachine Gun to have the One Handed trait. This not only allows it to be paired with the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]], but also allows the wielder to carry secondary objective objects like the [[SSSD Hard Drive]] or the [[Confidential Data]] or Mutated Egg from a [[Difficulty#Super Helldive|Super Helldive]] Mega Nest. ** The exploding tips of the bolts allow them to destroy enemy spawners, making it extremely useful when dispatching [[Bug Nest]]s or [[Automaton Outpost]]s. The weapon's semi-auto nature and generous magazine supply are well-suited to this task, as misses at long distance can be easily corrected and even Heavy Bug Nests can be cleared using this weapon alone. * Like other explosive weapons, the Exploding Crossbow can pose significant harm to the wielder if used up-close. It can be helpful to switch to a different weapon if enemies get too close for comfort. == Media == File:Crossbow, Weapon Wheel.png|Weapon Wheel File:Crossbow, Aiming, Third-Person.png|Aiming, The '''CQC-19 Stun Lance''' is a [[Melee]] [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Weapon]]. Attacking will thrust the lance at a moderately fast speed.

== Procurement ==
The Stun Lance is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Urban Legends Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|30}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

==Tactical Information==
=== Stun Lance Specific ===
* Unlike its other melee weapons the Stun Lance thrusts forwards at a decent range which allows you to target specific enemy parts, such as the head, to deal critical damage.
** The thrust also can only hit targets right in front the Helldiver, requiring more care taken if being surrounded by multiple targets.
* This weapon pairs well with the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|SH-20 Ballistic Shield]] as its narrow area of attack is remediated by the protection the shield offers.
** Unlike with other melee weapons the Helldiver will not move the shield off to the side to strike.
* Helldivers can swing the Stun Lance 25 times before running out of stamina. This number is not affected by Stamina Regen value or the [[Stamina Enhancement]] Booster.

=== Melee Weapons ===
* Melee weapons deal all of their damage to the first segment or "body part" of any given entity that they come into contact with. Additional segments of the same unit that the weapon passes through will be ignored.
** Wearing [[Armor]] with the [[Peak Physique]] or [[Rock Solid]] passive will increase melee damage by 40%, greatly increasing its lethality. Armor with the [[Reinforced Epaulettes]] passive will increase melee damage by 20%,.
* Melee weapons are able to hit multiple enemies with one thrust.
* Attacking with a melee weapon drains stamina.
** Holding the attack button will allow you to continuously attack, even when stamina is empty.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Melee]] [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Weapon]]. Attacking will slowly swing the Machete in a short range.

== Procurement ==
The Machete can be bought from the [[Dust Devils Premium Warbond|Dust Devils]] page on the [[Superstore]] for {{Currency|Super Credits|200}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

== Tactical Information ==
=== Machete Specific ===
* The Machete is considerably slower than other melee weapons in exchange for more damage. It requires careful timing and spacing to use effectively, as missing can be very punishing.
** While the velocity of the swing is slightly slower than a lance thrust, most of the "slow swing speed" comes from a post swing delay that also affects Helldiver's ability to move and sprint.
* The Machete is a serviceable melee weapon for killing [[Voteless]] due to its mostly horizontal attack pattern, however, its slow swing speed holds it back.
** Its attack pattern is as follows: From top right to bottom left, from top left to bottom right, from bottom right to top left, and finally from bottom left to top right. This X pattern repeats indefinitely. Its swings are much more horizontal than vertical, especially the final swing. This makes it far more consistent for chopping legs off Voteless hordes than the CQC-5 Combat Hatchet, arguably making it better suited against said units.
* It is highly advised to use a [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack]] to compensate the Machete's slow attacks with the protection the shield offers, note that the shield is moved off to the left to make room for the machete during a swing. 
** By blocking immediately after initiating the swing, however, the shield will be raised during the long reset time between attacks, thereby protecting you in your vulnerable state.
*The Machete has a higher than average stagger force compared to other melee weapons, it is capable of staggering [[Devastator|Devastators]], [[Berserker|Berserkers]], and medium sized [[Factions#Terminids|Terminids]].
* Due its slow attacks, Helldivers can swing the Machete and never fully drain their stamina.
* The Machete can be made to swing faster by utilizing animation cancelling techniques.
** This can be done by rebinding "Open Weapon Wheel" to another button and opening the menu mid swing, repeating the first swing animation much faster than the rest of the swings.
=== Melee Weapons ===
* Melee weapons deal all of their damage to the first segment or "body part" of any given entity that they come into contact with. Additional segments of the same unit that the weapon passes through will be ignored.
** Wearing [[Armor]] with the [[Peak Physique]] or [[Rock Solid]] passive will increase melee damage by 40%, greatly increasing its lethality. Armor with the [[Reinforced Epaulettes]] passive will increase melee damage by 20%,.
* The Machete is able to hit multiple enemies with one swing.
* Attacking with a melee weapon drains stamina.
** Holding the attack button will allow you to continuously attack, even when stamina is empty.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Melee]] [[Secondary weapon|Secondary Weapon]] that doubles as a shovel.

== Procurement ==
The CQC-73 Entrenchment Tool is unlocked from the [[Entrenched Division Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon|CQC-72 ENTRENCHMENT TOOL}} <!-- DO NOT CHANGE TO CQC-73. -->

== Tactical Information ==
=== CQC-73 Specific ===
* The main feature of the Entrenchment Tool is excavation of soft ground material by holding down "AIM"-button and then "fire". This action consumes stamina akin to weaponized melee strikes.
** Helldivers do not stop digging upon running out of stamina.
** The digging-motion also applies melee damage which also can be aimed any direction.
** Most hard materials such as pavement in [[Cities]] cannot be dug through, nor some areas too close to a structure or an objective like an [[Upload Escape Pod Data|Escape Pod]]. However, a texture is applied over the dug spot.
** Compared to using explosives, excavating using the Entrenchment Tool is slower but more precise and does not use ammunition.
* Trenches and foxholes dug using the Entrenchment Tool are helpful for providing cover in otherwise open areas for Helldivers and their equipment alike. 
** The [[A/M-12 Mortar Sentry]] and its variants benefit especially from being placed in a trench due to their indirect fire attack.

* This is a suitable melee weapon for killing [[Voteless]] due to its high damage and attack rate.
** Its standard attack pattern when not aiming consists of alternating diagonal swings, identical to the [[CQC-5 Combat Hatchet]].
** If not intending to excavate terrain, the [[CQC-2 Saber]] has slightly higher damage, attack rate, and maintains its wide attack pattern when aiming such as when raising up an [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack]].
* Helldivers can swing the {{PAGENAME}} 20 times before running out of stamina. This number is not affected by Stamina Regen value or the [[Stamina Enhancement]] Booster.

=== Melee Weapons ===
* Melee weapons deal all of their damage to the first segment or "body part" of any given entity that they come into contact with. Additional segments of the same unit that the weapon passes through will be ignored.
** Wearing [[Armor]] with the [[Peak Physique]] or [[Rock Solid]] passive will increase melee damage by 40%, greatly increasing its lethality. Armor with the [[Reinforced Epaulettes]] passive will increase melee damage by 20%,.
* Melee weapons are able to hit multiple enemies with one swing.
* Attacking with a melee weapon drains stamina.
** Holding the attack button will allow you to continuously attack, even when stamina is empty.

== Trivia ==
* There is a support weapon variant of this weapon, the [[CQC-72 Entrenchment Tool]], that can be found in various POI's.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a double-barreled [[Primary Weapon|Primary Shotgun]], compensating its limited capacity with massive stopping power.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} can be bought from the [[Python Commandos Premium Warbond|Python Commandos]] page in the [[Superstore]] for {{Currency|SC|400}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Double Freedom}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Due to the limited capacity, it is not recommended that Helldivers engage large groups of enemies with only the Double Freedom.
* Helldivers can set the Double Freedom to '''Volley''' mode to fire both barrels at once, providing a much larger burst of damage.
** The Double Freedom's volley mode is great for hitting the weak spots of heavy enemies at close distance, like [[Charger]] tails, [[Hulk]] vents, [[Impaler]] heads or [[Harvester]] joints. It doesn't have much use elsewhere, as the Double Freedom's massive damage of 840 is already enough to one-shot nearly any enemy in the game.
** Using Volley mode on close distance, Double Freedom is also capable to swiftly destroy structures such as [[Spore Spewer|Spore Spewer's]] or [[Enemy Bio-Processors|Bio-Processors]] and breaking [[Grounded Warp Ship]] shields.
* Using an armor passive that increases reload speed such as [[Siege-Ready]] or [[Reinforced Epaulettes]] is highly recommended due to how frequent the reloads are.

{{Last Updated|1.006.100}} {{Infobox Weapon | title = FLAM-66 Torcher | image = FLAM-66 Torcher Primary Render.png | caption-image = | damage = {{Damage|Fire|150 DPS}} | penetration = {{Armor|4}} | capacity = 100 | recoil = 2 | fire_rate = | reload_time = 3.25s | tac_reload_time = 3.25s | spare_mags = 6 | weapon_traits = Incendiary | firing_modes = None | scope_options = None | source = [[Freedom's Flame Premium Warbond#Page 2|Freedom's Flame]] {{Tooltip|P2|Page 2}} | cost = {{Currency|Medals|40}} | weapon_category= Primary Weapons | weapon_type= Special | supply_box_refill= | ammo_box_refill= }} {{Quote|A lightweight flamethrower. Shoots pressurized fuel through a dispersion nozzle into an open flame|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Special]] flamethrower. == Procurement == It is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Freedom's Flame Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon|FLAM-66 TORCHER}}
== Tactical Information == * The Torcher is a compact version of the [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]] that occupies the Primary Weapon slot; as such, it possesses similar characteristics. ** Like the basic Flamethrower, it has a range of 20m, measured in first person view. ** While this weapon's fuel canister is smaller than that of the FLAM-40, (100 vs. 150), it reloads faster and carries more spare canisters (6 vs. 5). *** Each canister contains enough fuel for 12.4 seconds of sustained fire, and fuel is not consumed by the pilot light ignition. * Before firing, the pilot light must be ignited by holding the fire button for roughly 0.7 seconds. It may be fired instantly at any time while the pilot light is active. ** It is a good habit to ignite the pilot light before an engagement to ensure that it can be fired immediately. This will ensure that the weapon is ready to face any oncoming threats. ** The pilot light only persists for roughly 10 seconds after the last time it is fired. This gives the weapon a grace period where it can still be immediately fired without having to re-ignite the pilot light. * Like the Flamethrower, the Torcher's primary role is to incinerate targets at close range by dousing them in fire, dealing direct flame damage while also inflicting damage over time with the fire status effect. ** With decent direct fire damage, the Torcher is able to kill medium enemy units quickly and excels at dispatching large groups of small enemies like [[Scavenger|Scavengers]], [[Pouncer|Pouncers]], and [[Voteless]]. ** Beware that even though it has better handling than the Flamethrower, the Torcher is still vulnerable to flanking, as the contact flames still take time to kill targets. Always be ready to retreat to re-orient against incoming threats, as the close combat nature of the weapon always leaves the wielder at risk of being surrounded and overwhelmed. ** Because of its short range, the Torcher is generally ineffective against [[Automatons]], due to most bots possessing laser and rocket weaponry that far outrange the Torcher. It is more useful against [[Terminids]] and [[Illuminate]], which have numerous melee-ranged enemies that must close to within the Torcher's attack range to fight. * A unique characteristic of the Torcher is that, like the Flamethrower, its particles have {{armor|4|ap}} armor penetration. This allows it to engage medium-sized enemies like [[Hive Guard]]s and [[Overseer]]s, and even take on heavy enemies like [[Charger]]s and [[Harvester]]s, though it will still take a moderate amount of time due to the weapon's relatively low damage output. * As with other fire-based weapons, this can be aimed at the ground to set it on fire, creating a zone where anything that steps foot inside (friend or foe) will be quickly inflicted with the fire status effect. ** Setting the ground on fire can be very effective in creating a defensive buffer zone. If anticipating an enemy approach, ignite a swathe of ground that the enemy must pass through, and then retreat. Enemies will be forced to walk on burning ground and take damage before they even come within range. ** Be very careful about which ground is ignited, as it may cut off maneuvering space for teammates. Always keep an eye on the locations of teammates as well as enemies, and avoid igniting areas that may become necessary escape routes. * Because of the way that flame particles spread after leaving the weapon, as well as burning terrain that naturally results from its use, it is very easy for the wielder to set themselves on fire. For this reason, it is highly recommended to utilize the [[Armor Passives|armor passives]] [[Inflammable]], [[Acclimated]], [[Kinetic Displacement Mitigation]], or [[Desert Stormer]] as they will greatly reduce the damage suffered from being set on fire. ===Known Issues=== * [[[1.001.100]]] Re-introduced collision issues with fire particles that causes flamethrower weapons to deal less DPS than intended. == Media == FLAM-66_Torcher_Weapon_Wheel.png|Weapon Wheel FLAM-66_Torcher_Third-Person.png|Aiming, Third-Person FLAM-66_Torcher_First-Person.png|Aiming, First-Person File:FLAM-66_Torcher_3rd_Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:FLAM-66_Torcher_1st_Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person == Trivia == * The Torcher bears a strong resemblance to the [[lexicanum:Pyreblaster|Pyreblaster]] from Warhammer 40,000. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.100|changes= Changes * Fire will now cause slowing effects and confusion effects on small to medium sized enemies of all factions while additionally affecting large Terminid enemies as well.}} {{Change History Update|1.003.000|changes= Change * Magazine capacity increased by 25% '''Damage'''
* Burning damage now scales with enemy size and will do more damage over time to larger enemies * Fire direct damage also scales with enemy size. The base damage of direct fire hits has been lowered as compensation. This means that large enemies will take roughly the same amount of damage as before, while smaller enemies will take slightly less. '''Time to Ignite'''
* Larger enemies now take longer to ignite. * Robotic enemies are harder to set on fire than organic ones. * Incendiary Ammunition and Lasers are now less effective at igniting enemies, but once they do, the resulting burn damage is more impactful thanks to the new scaling system. Undocumented Change * Reduced particle damage from 4 to 2 * Burn damage increased from 50 to 100. }} {{Change History Update|1.001.201|changes= Fixes * Fixed a rare crash related to Flamethrowers and Gas weapons. }} {{Change History Update|1.001.100|changes= Changes * Damage increased by 50%. ** Particle damage increased from 2 to 3, total damage from 250 to 375. * Flamer mechanics reverted to before the [[1.001.002|Escalation of Freedom]] update. * Armor penetration increased from {{armor|3|ap}} to {{armor|4|ap}}. }} {{Change History Update|1.001.004|changes= Fixes * Fixed an issue where flamethrower particles would ignore enemies. }} {{Change History Update|1.001.003|changes= Fixes * Fixed a bug where flamethrower weapons bounce off energy shields, making them useless when firing within shield generator relay domes. }} [[Category:Weapons|1]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Special Primaries]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__

{{Quote|A high explosive grenade which detonates on first impact.|Armory Description}}

The '''G-16 Impact''' is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] that explodes on impact with a surface or entity.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 5th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data Weapon}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The G-16 Impact can be used to target specific weak spots on an enemy. For example, the [[Annihilator Tank]] and [[Shredder Tank]] turret vents can be destroyed with two grenades. 
* The nature of the G-16 Impact can hinder the destruction of [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]], [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]], and [[Bulk Fabricator|Bulk Fabricators]], as it cannot fall into them like other grenades; it requires [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] to throw the grenade as close to the bottom of the hole or vent as possible.
** [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]] are an exception, as its open door is large enough for a Helldiver to easily toss the grenade in. 
* While the instant damage makes utilizing grenades for killing enemies easier, it does have its drawbacks.
** As the grenade lacks a fuse, it is not possible to "cook" the grenade to have it airburst above enemies. However, this allows it to be thrown farther than other grenades with a time fuze.
** Mobile enemies such as [[Hunter|Hunters]] or [[Voteless]] can potentially block the grenade's throwing arc, potentially killing the [[Helldiver]] throwing it. 
** Helldivers that manage to trip while holding the grenade will likely not survive the ensuing explosion at their feet.

{{Quote|A 'compliance weapon' to modify enemy behavior. Creates a thick smoke screen to block targets' line of sight.|Armory Description}}

The '''G-3 Smoke''' is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] that is used to create a temporary smoke screen to obscure [[Helldiver|Helldivers]].

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 8th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|25}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Rather than dealing [[Damage Types|damage]], this grenade creates three small smoke clouds that last for 30 seconds each. The clouds often coalesce to form one block of smoke, capable of obscuring the vision of both [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] and any [[Factions|Enemies]].
** As it lacks damage (and by extension, demolition force), the G-3 Smoke cannot destroy [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]], [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]], or [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]].
*** However even with the lack of damage and demolition force, the G-3 Smoke can still be used to exploit the [[Vox Engine|Vox Engine’s]] weak points, the top and bottom vent. A distinct advantage over the [[G-89 Smokescreen|G-89 Smokescreen]] which triggers on impact, making it harder to get in the vent. 
* Enemies that have lost sight with Helldivers entering smoke will still approach where they were last seen. Helldivers should continue retreating away from the smoke to better lose enemies' attention.
** Enemies can still detect Helldivers within the smoke if they are close enough. Helldivers should first disengage or eliminate nearby enemies before obscuring themselves with smoke.
* The {{Automaton}}[[Automatons]] are most affected by the G-3 Smoke due to their tendency to fight at range, making it easier to disengage.
* The {{Terminid}}[[Terminids]] are less affected by the G-3 Smoke, as they continuously move through the smoke towards their target's last known location. If far away enough from a chasing horde, Helldivers can utilize nearby terrain with smoke to break line of sight for a longer period of time.
* Similar to the Terminids, the {{Illuminate}}[[Illuminate]] are less affected by the G-3 Smoke as well, due to the rushing nature of the [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob|Fleshmobs]].
** The G-3 Smoke can be more effectively utilized to hamper attacks at range from [[Harvester|Harvesters]], [[Overseer|Overseers]], [[Elevated Overseer|Elevated Overseers]], and [[Crescent Overseer|Crescent Overseers]].
*The G-3 Smoke can also be used to carefully complete high-risk [[Missions|mission]] objectives, such as the [[Prospecting Drill|Prospecting Drills]] for the [[Conduct Geological Survey]]. The obscured [[Helldiver]] operating the drill can avoid being targeted by enemies pushing on the objective.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (simply known as a '''Seeker''') is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]'' that can fly around and explodes on impact. It will target the nearest enemy, but will prioritize a pinged enemy.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Servants of Freedom Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|65}}.

== Detailed Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|G-50 SEEKER}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Seeker grenade is impact-fused like the [[G-16 Impact]] and [[G-13 Incendiary Impact]] grenades and will instantly detonate once it hits a target, ground, wall, etc. 
** Damage from outside sources (explosions, being shot mid-flight by a Helldiver or enemy) will not detonate the Seeker grenade.
* Seeker grenades have a detection/seeking radius seems to be about 50 meters.
** Seeker grenades seem to ignore their range limit when targeting [[Gunship|Gunships]].
* It takes 2 Seeker grenades to the heatsink of a [[Tank]] or [[Cannon Turret]] to destroy it.
* If a Seeker grenade detects no targets after being thrown, it will hover around the user until a target comes within range, or until its 30s lifetime is depleted. If the battery runs out, the G-50 will harmlessly fall to the ground rather than explode.
* Seeker grenades cannot destroy spawners such as [[Automaton Fabricator|Fabricators]].
* Seeker grenades are able to pass through [[Harvester]] shields.
* Seeker grenades will prioritize homing in on enemy targets that are marked (pinged) by the Helldiver that threw them, given that the marked targets are within the Seeker grenade's range .
** Seeker grenades themselves can be pinged, although there isn't really any use in doing so.
* Seeker grenades will prioritize attacking - and are notably effective against - aerial targets, typically only taking 1 - 2 to destroy [[Gunship|Gunships]], or strafing [[Stingray|Stingrays]].
* It only takes 1 Seeker grenade to take out [[Elevated Overseer|Elevated Overseers]].

== Trivia ==
* The G-50 Seeker was the first grenade in the game that could fly and target enemies, making it smarter than the standard grenade.

== Known Issues ==
* The Seeker currently leaves some enemies it hits on 1 HP, even on a normally fatal hit. 
* Seeker grenades currently can destroy [[Automaton Fabricator|Fabricators]] and [[Grounded Warp Ship|Warp Ships]] if marked (pinged) by passing through structure model and detonating near destruction hitbox.

{{Quote|A smoke grenade that rapidly deploys a small, dense cloud. Allows for rapid personal concealment and exfiltration.|Armory Description}}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] that is used to create a temporary smoke screen to obscure [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] upon impact.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} can be bought from the [[Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond|Redacted Regiment]] page on the [[Superstore]] for {{Currency|SC|300}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data Weapon}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Rather than dealing [[Damage Types|damage]], this grenade creates three small smoke clouds that last for 30 seconds each. The clouds often coalesce to form one block of smoke, capable of obscuring the vision of both [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] and any [[Factions|Enemies]].
** As it lacks damage (and by extension, demolition force), the G-89 Smokescreen cannot destroy [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]], [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]], or [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]].
* Compared to the [[G-3 Smoke]], the G-89 Smokescreen has no fuse time and instead creates a smoke cloud on impact. This feature prevents cases where it could bounce unpredictably and create a cloud of smoke in an undesired place, and allows for more immediate deployment.
** In exchange, the G-89 Smokescreen has a noticeably smaller radius of created smoke comparing to its counterpart. 
* Enemies that have lost sight with Helldivers entering smoke will still approach where they were last seen. Helldivers should continue retreating away from the smoke to better lose enemies' attention.
** Enemies can still detect Helldivers within the smoke if they are close enough. Helldivers should first disengage or eliminate nearby enemies before obscuring themselves with smoke.
* The {{Automaton}}[[Automatons]] are most affected by the G-89 Smokescreen due to their tendency to fight at range, making it easier to disengage.
* The {{Terminids}}[[Terminids]] are less affected by the G-89 Smokescreen, as they continuously move through the smoke towards their target's last known location. If far away enough from a chasing horde, Helldivers can utilize nearby terrain with smoke to break line of sight for a longer period of time.
* Similar to the Terminids, the {{Illuminate}}[[Illuminate]] are less affected by the G-89 Smokescreen as well, due to the rushing nature of the [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob|Fleshmobs]].
** The G-89 Smokescreen can be more effectively utilized to hamper attacks at range from [[Harvester|Harvesters]], [[Overseer|Overseers]], [[Elevated Overseer|Elevated Overseers]], and [[Crescent Overseer|Crescent Overseers]].
* The G-89 Smokescreen can also be used to carefully complete high-risk [[Missions|mission]] objectives, such as the [[Prospecting Drill|Prospecting Drills]] for the [[Conduct Geological Survey]]. The obscured [[Helldiver]] operating the drill can avoid being targeted by enemies pushing on the objective.

{{DisambigMsg|the throwable|the support weapon|40-K Meltagun}} {{Last Updated|1.007.000}} {{Infobox Throwable | title = {{PAGENAME}} | image = G-40-K Melta Mine Throwable Render.png | damage = {{Damage|Explosion|2,000}}

During the Fall of Chara, it is said that enough Melta Mines were detonated to outshine the planet's sun.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] that deploys a proximity mine which, when detonated, releases a large column of superheated thermal energy before exploding. == Procurement == The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Castellan’s Creed Legendary Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|50}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|G/40-K Melta Mine}} == Tactical Information == * The Melta Mine is similiar to the [[G-48 Giga Grenade]], boasting anti-tank armor penetration, high damage, sizeable AoE, and very short throwing distance. ** It has a significantly shorter throwing range than other throwables, only being able to be thrown a few meters away. It is highly recommended to aim upwards when throwing. *** Helldivers can utilize the [[Desert Stormer]] or [[Servo-Assisted]] armor passives to increase throwing range. * It does not have a standard fuse - it will remain where it is thrown like [[Mines (disambiguation)|Mines]]. It will detonate when medium or heavy enemies step on the Mine. ** While attached to a surface and armed, the mine exudes a visual heatwave effect that can help with keeping track of where mines were thrown. *** Melta Mines can stick to most surfaces, including backpacks of the [[SEAF Soldier|SEAF]] troops. * When detonated, the Melta Mine first deploys a large column of superheated thermal energy that deals massive damage, capable of killing large enemies such as [[Hulk]]s and [[Charger]]s. Then it detonates again with a "flamewall" that '''only''' deals {{Damage|Fire}} damage and does '''not''' inflict fire DoT. ** It does not detonate on light enemies, and can be safely walked over by Helldivers. Instead, they are only triggered by medium or heavy units. ** It can be manually detonated by shooting at it from a safe distance. [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]] and [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]] are able to be destroyed from the outside. ** The "flamewall" part of the damage hits twice in short succession, for a total of {{Damage|Fire|1,200}} damage. ** Hitting a target with both the explosion and flame does a combined 3,200 damage, allowing for an Automaton [[Destroy Command Bunkers|Command Bunker]] to be destroyed with a single mine. This can be reliably achieved by placing the mine next to the structure underneath the bunker turret emplacements. * If a Helldiver can get close enough, a single Mine can be thrown through the shield of [[Harvester|Harvesters]] and detonate on one of its legs - killing them instantly. * Helldivers should be careful when throwing Melta Mines in the presence of agile enemies such as [[Wretch]]s, as they can detonate mines in the middle of their pounce. * Teammates that utilize vehicle stratagems such as Exosuits should be wary of Melta Mines as they are heavy enough to detonate them. ==Trivia== * The Warhammer 40,000 [[lexicanum:Melta_Mine|Melta Mine]] had, prior to the Castellan's Creed Legendary Warbond, never been depicted in action by official media from Games Workshop. Making Helldivers 2 the first game to feature an "official" depiction of the Melta Mine in action.https://youtu.be/qpWSTUq5yPQ?t=69 == Media == File:G40-K_Melta_Mine_Held.png|Before Throwing File:G40-K_Melta_Mine_Deployed.gif|Deployed == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.007.100|changes= Changes *The Melta Mine can no longer attach to characters and vehicles. *The Melta Mine can land and rest on sufficiently level surfaces of characters and vehicles. *The Mine will arm based on a timer from the throw unless it attaches to terrain. }} {{Change History Update|1.007.000|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.301|date=2026-07-30|changes= Announced }} [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Standard Throwables]] {{Nav Weapon}}

{{Quote|A throwable emplacement that generates a spherical, projectile-blocking shield on impact. Has a limited lifetime once deployed.|Armory Description}}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]]
that projects a small bubble shield with 360° coverage to block incoming projectiles. 

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Siege Breakers Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|65}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|G/SH-39 Shield}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The {{PAGENAME}} protects units inside the shield from point blank [[Ultimatum]], [[Solo Silo]], [[Leveller]], and [[Orbital Precision Strike]] explosions (as well as the explosions from [[Walking Barrage]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] and [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage]] shells), but not impacts, as those will destroy the shield with the impact damage before the explosion triggers. 
** A direct hit is survivable by stacking shields. Helldivers will not be ragdolled when protected from these hits.
** Combining the G/SH-39 Shield with a Leveller shot point-blank at a [[Vox Engine]]'s underside vent is the most consistent method to dispatch them in one shot.
*The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to provide impromptu cover for [[Emplacement Stratagems|emplacements]] and [[Sentry Stratagems|sentries]].
**It can also be used to protect a [[Hellbomb]] from being destroyed or prematurely detonated by enemy fire.
* The {{PAGENAME}} will not protect units inside the shield from [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]] and [[Hellbomb]] explosions within the inner radius of those explosions (10 and 17 meters respectively). 
** Helldivers outside the inner radius of these explosions can still be ragdolled and sent flying by the explosion through the shield. 
** Stacking shields provides no protective benefits against these explosions.
* The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to survive many situations that would otherwise be fatal, such as landing in front of a fully armed and operational [[Factory Strider]], being strafed by a [[Stingray]], or being surrounded by multiple [[Stalker]]s. 
** Since the Shield must be thrown first, it is recommended to use it proactively, not reactively.
** Terminids can walk through the Shield, but due to its small size, if a Helldiver stands in the middle of the shield, Terminids will not attempt to walk through the shield and instead attack the Helldiver fruitlessly.
*The G/SH-39 Shield can be used to defend a Helldiver while interacting with terminals. This is notably useful while arming Hellbombs as the shield is large enough to protect both the Hellbomb and the Helldiver from enemy fire.
* Similar to the [[FX-12 Shield Generator Relay]], the {{PAGENAME}} can shelter Helldivers from weather hazards like [[Acid Storms]], negating their effects upon them.

Its manual single-round reload makes it a highly methodical choice for squads requiring an explosive approach to dispute resolution.|Armory Description}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Explosive-0|Explosive primary]] weapon that fires high-damaging grenades that explode upon impact. The pump handle chambers each round, similar to a pump-action shotgun. == Procurement == The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Ironclad Democracy Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|65}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|GL-15 Evictor}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Evictor}} ==Tactical Information == * The Evictor excels at delivering devastating damage with each shot but suffers from a very low fire rate and limited ammo capacity. ** The weapon’s action must be manually cycled after each shot, giving it a considerably slow rate of fire. * The explosive grenades of the Evictor are highly versatile, capable of dealing both high single-target and area damage. ** Medium/Large enemies will take small damage from the projectile impact and explosion AoE all at once. This combined damage can eliminate most medium-sized enemies in one or two shots. ** Groups of small enemies can be quickly killed, as they are easily damaged by the large explosion. *** This is especially effective against [[Terminids]], allowing a single shot to wipe out entire patrols of [[Pouncer]]s, [[Bile Spitter]]s, or even [[Bile Spewer]]s (via chain reaction). * The [[Demolition|Demo Force]] of the Evictor's explosion makes it effective against enemy spawners and certain [[Missions#Tactical Objectives|mission objectives]]. A single round can destroy a [[Bug Hole]], [[Automaton Fabricator]]s, and [[Grounded Warp Ship]]s by hitting their weak spots. ** Since the Evictor reloads swiftly like a shotgun, it outperforms other loadout weapons (like the [[GP-31 Grenade Pistol]] and the [[CB-9 Exploding Crossbow]]) in its ability to tackle a series of Bug Holes without lengthy pauses to reload. This can prove invaluable when wading into a nest, where Helldivers will need to stay on the move if they want to survive. * Because of the explosion dealt at the point of impact, Helldivers can easily kill themselves by accident by shooting targets that are too close. This same care should be extended to allies as well. * A reliable Secondary or rapid-fire Support Weapon is recommended to deal with enemies at close range. Pistols like the [[P-113 Verdict]] and [[LAS-58 Talon]] can quickly kill individual targets, while Support Weapons like the [[MG-43 Machine Gun]] or [[M-105 Stalwart]] are effective options for several close-range enemies. ** Drone backpacks like the [[AX/AR-23 Guard Dog]] or [[AX/LAS-5 Rover]] can also be useful, killing most small enemies before they can get too close. == Media == File:GL-15_Evictor_WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:GL-15_Evictor_3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:GL-15_Evictor_1st.png|Aiming, First-Person File:GL-15_Evictor_3rd_Reloads.gif|Reloading, Third-Person (full and partial) File:GL-15_Evictor_1st_Reloads.gif|Reloading, First-Person (full and partial) == Trivia == * The Evictor appears to be based on the prototype [[wp:China_Lake_grenade_launcher|China Lake pump-action grenade launcher]]. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.007.100|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} {{Change History Update|1.007.002|date=2026-09-15|changes= Announced https://blog.playstation.com/2026/09/15/helldivers-2-ironclad-democracy-warbond-launches-sept-22/ }} ==References== [[Category:Weapons|1]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Explosive]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__

The weight of the projectile limits the weapon's range.|Armory Description}} The '''Ultimatum''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Special]], powerful single-shot weapon that fires extremely destructive explosive rounds. == Procurement == The Ultimatum is unlocked on page 2 of [[Servants of Freedom Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack Data Weapon|GP-20 ULTIMATUM}} == Tactical Information == * Operating similarly to the [[GP-31 Grenade Pistol]], the Ultimatum fires a single powerful anti-tank explosive round and has to be reloaded after every shot. ** Also like the Grenade Pistol, equipping the Ultimatum means forgoing a reliable secondary weapon for dealing with close range threats. * The Ultimatum is capable of killing most enemies in a single shot. * The Ultimatum's high damage, armor penetration, and demolition force of 40 allows it to demolish various structures such as [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]] (including [[Bile Titan Bug Hole|Bile Titan Bug Holes]]) and [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]] from the outside. ** [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]] can also be destroyed from the outside due to taking increased explosive damage. * A weakness of the Ultimatum is its very short range. ** When standing still and firing parallel to the ground, the projectile has a range of approximately 17 meters. When firing at a 45° angle, it is increased to approximately 40 meters. ** The user's velocity is transferred to the projectile when fired. Diving, using the [[LIFT-850 Jump Pack]], riding in a [[M-102 Fast Recon Vehicle]], or using the [[Raise Weapon]] emote can greatly influence its range. * Another significant weakness is its low ammo capacity. ** Regardless of any [[Armor Passives]], its reserve ammunition can never be increased. ** [[Supplies#Ammo Box|Ammo Boxes]] disproportionately benefit the Ultimatum, granting full reserve ammunition. == Media == File:GP-20 Ultimatum WW.png|Weapon Wheel Servants of Freedom Premium Warbond Marketing.jpg|Warbond Marketing File:GP-20 Ultimatum 3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:GP-20 likely inspired by the German [[WP:Kampfpistole|Kampfpistole]], a World War II flare pistol of the Wehrmacht that was later modified to fulfill the role of a short-ranged grenade launcher by firing a Must be reloaded between shots.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Special]] single-shot weapon that fires a powerful grenade at a medium range. == Procurement == It is unlocked on the Page 3 of [[Democratic Detonation Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|GP-31 GRENADE PISTOL}} == Tactical Information == * The Grenade Pistol is a very useful utility secondary weapon, as it can inflict explosive damage. ** In particular, when used properly it is capable of destroying [[Terminid Nest]]s and [[Automaton Fabricator]]s, allowing the wielder to equip a different type of grenade such as [[G-23 Stun]] while retaining the ability to destroy enemy spawners. ** The explosive and splash nature of the grenades allows the Grenade Pistol to dispatch multiple enemies with a single shot, or inflict significant Structural damage to large body parts such as the thorax of [[Bile Spewer]]s. * Because of its significant falling arc, it can be very difficult to land precise shots at long distances since gravity must be accounted for. Be sure to practice in order to get used to the arc. * Be wary when using this weapon, as it is very easy to exhaust its ammo supply. When picking up supplies from a [[Resupply]] or [[B-1 Supply Pack]] four grenades will be replenished, and when picking up an [[Supplies#Ammo Box|Ammo Box]] two grenades will be replenished; Grenade Cases do not replenish the Grenade Pistol. Be sure to balance grenade consumption with that of the primary and support weapons. * Be careful when firing the Grenade Pistol at very close range, as the fuse has a range safety that prevents it from detonating too close to the wielder. If the grenade hits an enemy at point-blank range, it will simply bounce off and ricochet, exploding far from its intended target. * The One Handed trait means that the Grenade Pistol can be used while holding items like the [[SSSD Hard Drive]] or while wielding the [[Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]], and it will be automatically equipped in these cases if no other weapons with One Handed are equipped. * The Grenade Pistol makes no noise when fired, allowing it to destroy Terminid Nests and Automaton Fabricators without alerting nearby enemies. The explosion can also be used to distract enemy patrols. == Media == GP-31 Grenade Pistol Weapon Wheel.png|Weapon Wheel GP-31 Grenade Pistol Weapon Aim.png|Aiming, Third-Person GP-31 Grenade Pistol Weapon Scope.png|Aiming, First-Person File:GP-31 Grenade Pistol 3rd Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:GP-31 Grenade Pistol 1st Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person ==Trivia== *The {{PAGENAME}} was suggested by an R&D intern who was executed for making an unauthorized suggestion to a superior and posthumously promoted to Sergeant.[https://Twitter.com/helldivers2/status/1782764227079405700 https://twitter.com/helldivers2/status/1782764227079405700] == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.001|changes= Change * Decreased sway modifier from 1.2 to 1 }} {{Change History Update|1.003.000|changes= Change * Sway increased from 1 to 1.2 }} {{Change History Update|1.001.002|changes= Changes * Decreased ammo capacity from 8 to 6. * Increased the number of rounds replenished from an ammo box from 2 to 4. * Moved into a Special sidearm category. }} {{Change History Update|1.000.300|changes= Fix * Explosive weapons no longer pull players inward from the blast. }} {{Change History Update|1.000.202|date=2024-04-11|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} ==References== [[Category:Weapons|2]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Special Secondaries]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__

The '''JAR-5 Dominator''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Special]] weapon that fires highly damaging rounds in exchange for a severely restricted magazine size.

== Procurement ==
The Dominator is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|80}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|JAR-5 DOMINATOR}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Dominator}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Dominator functions as a sort of Marksman Rifle, utilizing powerful rounds that inflict high damage in exchange for a low fire-rate and very high recoil.
** The key feature of the Dominator is its jet-propelled ammunition, which inflicts high damage and extreme stagger, while having 0 bullet drag (meaning it deals full damage no matter the range) and almost no bullet drop.
* A single round from the Dominator is capable of killing any small enemy regardless of hit locations, and similarly dispatch medium-sized foes by hitting their weak spots.
** Each round inflicts a significant amount of durable damage, so even when fighting enemies with durable body parts like [[Alpha Commander]]s, the Dominator is still capable of making short work of them.
** The Stagger Force of each round is virtually guaranteed to interrupt the actions of any foe it hits, even the likes of [[Heavy Devastator]]s, [[Berserker]]s and [[Stalker]]s.
*The Dominator suffers from a low ergonomics stat, which means the weapon is slower to follow the player's crosshair and generally has to be "dragged" around. This can be mitigated by equipping armor with the [[Armor Passives|Peak Physique]] passive.
* The Dominator by default has a red dot sight with no magnification options, hence it functions poorly at long range.
* One of the Dominator's greatest weaknesses is its small magazine size, only holding 15 rounds.
** For this reason, it is very important to make each round count. Never fire more than a single round at small enemies and try to dispatch medium enemies efficiently by aiming at their weak points.
** Having a reliable Secondary Weapon is important account for the Dominator's lack of ammo and long reload. Using a pistol like the [[P-2 Peacemaker]] or [[P-113 Verdict]] to dispatch weaker enemies can save the Dominator's scarce ammunition for handling tougher foes.
*The 4x Combat Scope is misaligned with the Dominator's true direction of fire, requiring the user to manually compensate:
**Close range (~0m): Align the target with the inner edge of the green ring above the centre dot. This compensates for the upward launch bias and gets you clean headshots or solid center-mass hits.
**Mid range (~30m): Align the target with the centre dot.
**Long range (>100m): Align the target with the middle of the green arrow below the centre dot.
