The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] that can be used for silent takedowns, especially suited to [[Stealth]] playstyles.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Viper Commandos Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|medals|60}}.

== Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Knives will fly slightly to the left of the crosshair and have a modest arc to their flight path, necessitating a fair amount of skill and practice to land consistent weak spot hits.
* The throwing knife can bypass shields (such as the [[SH-32 Shield Generator Pack]]'s) under certain circumstances.
* Thrown knives cannot currently be retrieved, regardless of where they've landed. The K-2 also cannot be used in melee, even if specifically wielded.
* The Throwing Knives are thrown silently, they will not alert static enemies if you miss or kill nearby enemy with a single throw.
** Killing any unit in patrol with a knife will be noticed by the rest of the enemy group, forcing them to search your last known location.
* It is possible to disable [[Automaton Mine|Automaton Mines]] by throwing knives at them. The knife must not hit the mine directly - as this will cause the mine to detonate - but instead hit the ground right next to the mine. Shooting a disabled mine will still cause it to explode.
* Knives can be used to destroy Ammo Dumps in [[Sabotage Supply Bases]] missions.
* Resupplying from the [[B-1 Supply Pack|Supply Pack]] or the [[Resupply]] stratagem will refill 20 knives.
* Knives can be used to silently dispatch [[Agitator|Agitators]] with a single headshot.

== Trivia ==

* Knives can bypass shields at low speeds, which seems to be a reference to the [[wikipedia:Dune_(novel)|Dune]]<nowiki/>series of books. 

== Known Issues ==

* When hosting a game, Helldivers may often experience a bug where their throwing knives will alert nearby enemies when they are thrown, or when they miss their target. Enemies may also be alerted even if a nearby enemy was taken out in one knife. To alleviate this, the knife wielder should designate another Helldiver as the host.

The '''LAS-12 Sai''' is a [[Weapons#Energy-Based-0|Primary Energy-Based]] submachine gun with high damage and spread.

== Procurement ==
The LAS-12 Sai can be bought from the [[Ironclad Democracy Premium Warbond|Ironclad Democracy]] page on the [[Superstore]] for 400 {{Currency|Super Credits|}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|LAS-12 Sai}}

== Attachments Table ==
{{Attachments Table|Sai}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Compared to the [[LAS-16 Sickle]], the Sai has increased armor penetration and deals more damage, but at the cost of significant spread, slightly less durable damage, and a shorter fire limit.
* Because of its immense spread, the Sai is best used in close quarters, similar to other SMGs like the  [[SMG/FLAM-34 Stoker]].
** The Sai's spread is comparable to that of a shotgun, like the [[SG-8 Punisher]]. 
** The Sai's spread can be roughly cut in half by using the [[Focus Lens]] at the cost of a fire rate reduction of 25% (800 to 600). It remains inaccurate for hitting small weak points outside of close range. 
* Due to the Sai's nature as a heat-based weapon, the Sai has the potential to never run out of ammo and is affected by [[Intense Heat]] & [[Extreme Cold]] modifiers.
** The Sai can accumulate heat less quickly by using the Focus Lens due to it lowering the fire rate of the weapon.
** Unlike other heat-based weapons, it does not have a faster "full" reload versus its "tactical" reload because the ICE is not ejected automatically when burned out. If a Helldiver is committed to a full reload instead of letting it cool down, it doesn't matter much if they reload it early or let it overheat if they want to save time.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Shotgun|Primary Energy-Based]] shotgun in ''[[Helldivers 2]].'' It fires multiple beams per shot and ammunition capacity is only limited by heat accumulation within the weapon.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Siege Breakers Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon|LAS-13 Trident}}

==Attachments Table==
{{Attachments Table|Trident}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Trident is a side-grade to the [[SG-225 Breaker]], providing very high damage against large groups of [[Factions|Enemies]] at close range.
** The Trident fires 6 beams per shot along a very wide horizontal spread.
** Due to it's massive [[Duckbill|duckbill]]-style spread, the Trident struggles to hit smaller weakpoints at range, such as [[Devastator]] heads.
** Like the Breaker, [[Helldiver]]s are advised to tap-fire the Trident instead of firing in full-auto, as to preserve the very few heat sinks that it has spare.
* The Trident is very effective against large groups of lightly armored enemies, such as [[Voteless]], [[Trooper]]s and several types of [[Terminids]].
* Being a shotgun, the Trident's main weakness is its spread, making it less effective at range than other [[Weapons#Primary-0|Primary Weapons]].
** Additionally, the Trident's spread is very dramatic and unpredictable. Some beams may hit towards the center of the reticle while others may drag very far to one side.
* Like other [[Weapons#Energy-Based-0|laser weapons]], the Trident has a very low stagger force, meaning that enemies will not be slowed or staggered after being hit, which can be problematic in close quarters.
* Due to the Trident's nature as a laser weapon, the Trident has the potential to never run out of ammo, and is affected by the [[Intense Heat]] & [[Extreme Cold]] modifiers.
** Since the Trident's rate of fire is much slower than other laser weapons, it will begin to cool down before the next shot is fired, making its effective firing time (in full auto) roughly 2.75s on standard and Intense Heat weather, and 3.5s on Extreme Cold weather.
* Uniquely, the Trident fires individual bursts of beams, rather than energy projectiles like the [[LAS-16 Sickle]], or a continuous beam like the [[LAS-5 Scythe]].
** However, unlike other beam-firing laser weapons, the Trident does not set enemies on fire.

The '''LAS-16 Sickle''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Energy-Based]] weapon that operates like an Assault Rifle, shooting targets with a barrage of laser pulses. 

== Procurement ==
The Sickle is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Cutting Edge Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|LAS-16 SICKLE}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Sickle}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Sickle fires bursts of lasers in a manner similar to Assault Rifles, relying on replaceable Internal Cooling Elements to operate.
** The Sickle can be fired continuously for up to 7 seconds before its ICE burns out, and needs to be spun up for roughly 0.5 seconds before it begins firing.
** From nearly maximum heat, the weapon requires 12.5 seconds to fully cool down. This is affected by [[Extreme Cold]] and [[Intense Heat]], which causes the weapon to cool down 50% faster or 25% slower, respectively.
** Like other heat-based weapons, if the ICE burns out, it must be replaced before the weapon can be fired again. The Sickle can carry up to three spare ICE units, giving a tolerable amount of leeway for overheating the weapon.
* As it functions effectively like a heat-based Assault Rifle, the Sickle is a dependable weapon that offers potentially infinite ammunition in exchange for fire discipline.
** The weapon's fire rate and ICE limit give it a maximum of 87 consecutive shots before it burns out. If the weapon is allowed to cool down between engagements, it is possible to never have to reload it.
** Because its effective magazine size is almost twice what the [[AR-23 Liberator|Liberator]] family carries, the Sickle has a respectable amount of staying power. Even in the worst-case situation where the player must burn out its ICE, it is capable of inflicting more damage using a single "magazine" than most Assault Rifles.
* Effective use of the Sickle requires managing its heat buildup. It is crucial to ''not'' fire the weapon occasionally in order to prevent its ICE from burning out.
** However, there may come situations where it is better to expend the weapon's ICE in order to maximize damage output, and reload the weapon. As it carries three spare ICE units, expending one is not a major detriment.
*** Like other heat-based weapons, the fully overheated reload process is faster than a partially spent reload becuase the ICE ejects itself hands-free at the moment it overheats. If a Helldiver wishes to save time reloading, they may want to fully burn it out instead of reloading manually when ''almost'' burned out.
** Choosing proper Secondary and Support Weapons can help to maximize the Sickle's potential. As it will continue to cool down even when using a different weapon, bringing a reliable alternate weapon to bear when the Sickle's ICE is almost fully burnt out can buy it time to cool down.
* Compared to its cousin the [[LAS-5 Scythe|Scythe]], the Sickle boasts roughly twice the damage output, but is less precise due to spread and recoil. It is also incapable of setting targets on fire.
* The Sickle's sole [[Combat#The Weapon Wheel|Weapon Wheel]] firing option is the sight's zoom level. Helldivers can choose between 25m, 50m, and 100m zoom levels. 
** An effective strategy is to use first-person aiming to utilize the 100m scope setting for precision shooting, such as firing at [[Automatons|Automaton]] heads, and switching to third-person aiming when precision is less important. This grants the ability to quickly swap between two different zoom levels, without having to open the Weapon Wheel.

{{Last Updated|1.006.202}} {{Infobox_Weapon | title = LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle | image = LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle Primary Render.png | caption-image = | damage = {{Damage|Ballistic|55-70 Projectile|notext}} | penetration = {{armor|4|ap}} | capacity = 15s (175) (Fires Indefinitely) | recoil = 2 | tac_reload_time = 2.83s | fire_rate = 700 rpm | dps = 700 (0-25% heat) {{*}} 641.67 (26-50% heat) {{*}} 816.67 (51-100% heat) | spare_mags = 3 | weapon_traits = Light Armor Penetrating {{*}} Medium Armor Penetrating {{*}} Heavy Armor Penetrating {{*}} Heat | firing_modes = Automatic | scope_options = 25m {{*}} 50m {{*}} 100m | source = [[Servants of Freedom Premium Warbond#Page 1|Servants of Freedom]] {{Tooltip|P1|Page 1}} | cost = {{Currency|Medals|35}} | weapon_category = Primary Weapons | weapon_type = Energy-Based | supply_box_refill = 3 | ammo_box_refill = 3 }} {{Quote|A LAS-16 Sickle model with all overheating protections conveniently removed, allowing for far longer bursts of fire. Does more damage when overheating, at the cost of slightly burning the user.|Armory Description}} The '''LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Energy-Based]] weapon that operates like an assault rifle, shooting targets with a barrage of laser pulses but will damage the user after prolonged firing. == Procurement == The Double-Edge Sickle is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Servants of Freedom Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack Data Weapon|LAS-17 DOUBLE-EDGE SICKLE}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Double-Edge Sickle}} == Functionality == The LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle is a [[LAS-16 Sickle]] with all overheating protections conveniently removed, expelling excess heat to the user. This allows it to fire for much longer before reaching maximum heat, and the heatsink does not need to be replaced upon reaching maximum heat. As the weapon heats up, the laser pulses it fires increase in power, but so does the damage dealt to the user when firing: * '''0-25% heat:''' Laser pulses are {{Armor|2|AP}} armor penetrating and deal 60 damage. Does not deal damage to the user. * '''26-50% heat:''' Laser pulses are {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetrating and deal 55 damage. Deals 10 heat damage per second to the user. ** Visually, the weapon starts to emit sparks from the sides as it fires, as well as bursts of fire. This can cause visual noise in first-person mode, but otherwise, visual clarity is unaffected. * '''51-90% heat:''' Laser pulses are {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetrating and deal 70 damage. Deals 20 heat damage a second to the user. ** Visually, the weapon starts smoking and emitting even more sparks and flames. Visual clarity in first-person mode is moderately affected, but still allows for some use. * '''91%+ heat:''' Laser pulses are {{Armor|4|AP}} armor penetrating and deal 70 damage. Sets the user on fire and deals 50 heat damage a second (in addition to damage from being set on fire.) Without proper resistances, this stage is incredibly lethal and is very likely to kill the user. ** Visually, the weapon fully catches on fire, billowing smoke, and emitting an extreme amount of sparks in every direction. First-person mode is nigh useless at this point, and the sheer number of sparks can even make it difficult to tell if your shots are landing in third-person mode. The Double-Edge Sickle is not affected by [[Intense Heat]], but cools down 50% faster on planets with [[Extreme Cold]]. == Tactical Information == This weapon has the potential for massive suppressive damage, but at a steep cost- the self-inflicted damage can eventually kill its user, and can only be mitigated, not completely removed. Several items can reduce the burden of the burn damage for Helldivers trying to make the most of this weapon; * Wearing an [[Inflammable]] armor set reduces burn damage to a quarter of its normal value. [[Acclimated]] and [[Desert Stormer]] also decrease burn Damage by 50% and 40% respectively in addition to their other effects. Heavier variants of these armors allow for longer firing periods before taking damage compared to lighter options. * The [[Vitality Enhancement]] booster reduce all ticks of damage by a flat amount. ** If combined with Acclimated or Desert Stormer, burn damage is reduced enough that the Double-Edge Sickle is unable to harm the user until passing 51% heat. ** If combined with Inflammable, burn damage is reduced enough that the Double-Edge Sickle is unable to harm the user until passing 91% heat. ** When passing the safe level of heat, further damage can be mitigated by burst firing the Double-Edge Sickle for under a second. However, doing this will impact the damage per second. * When the weapon passes 91% heat, going prone prevents the user from being set on fire. This can greatly improve its use time at this level of heat. * Using a [[Stim]] when the burning is too much to bear can keep the shooter alive as long as they have spare stims. This can be supported by the [[Med-Kit]] passive and/or [[Experimental Infusion]] booster. The [[P-11 Stim Pistol]] can provide healing to Double-Edge Sickle users, and benefits from the aforementioned perks. While it has the longest firing capacity of any LAS weapon (theoretically infinite), it has the longest cooling time of its family. Reloading a new ICE will reset the heat quickly, but also remove the bonus damage that comes with it. Regardless, it can still be prudent to simply reload the weapon after reaching dangerous heat thresholds during extended engagements; expending an ICE is often more economical than continuing to fire at high temperatures and using up valuable stims. * The Double-Edge Sickle cannot actually exceed 100% heat, so the cooldown remains the same regardless of how long it is used at this level. * Only the third round shot from a 91%+ heat Double-Edge Sickle will damage the user. This allows the user to fire {{Armor|4|AP}} laser pulses indefinitely, but greatly impacts damage per second. Useful for gravely injured Helldivers that are in desperate encounters. ** As the Double-Edge Sickle accumulates heat, sparks, smoke, and flames will fly toward the Helldiver firing it. This increases in intensity as heat rises. At high levels of heat, this obscures the Helldiver's vision when firing in first-person mode, and can even make third-person aiming more difficult. === Resistance Chart === If marked with an X, the combination at the listed heat level will take ''no'' damage, and is completely safe. If unmarked, Helldivers will still take damage (albeit sometimes minimally) with the combination at the listed heat level. Armor class does not affect the amount of damage received. The '''LAS-5 Scythe''' is a [[Weapons#Energy-Based-0|Primary Energy-Based]] laser rifle with infinite ammo. The weapons ammunition capacity is only limited by heat accumulation within the weapon. 

== Procurement ==
The Scythe is unlocked on the 5th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|30}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Scythe}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Enemies hit by the laser beam will ignite, and take [[Status_Effects#Fire|fire damage]]. This makes hitting weak spots less important, and allows Helldivers to engage other units while others burn.
* Due to the Scythe's nature as a heat-based weapon, the Scythe has the potential to never run out of ammo, and is affected by the [[Intense Heat]] & [[Extreme Cold]] modifiers. This means the Scythe takes longer to cool down on hot planets and cools down faster on cold planets.
** The long cooldown time on [[Intense Heat]] planets can be mitigated by equipping the [[High Dissipation Heatsink]]. Alternatively, using the [[High Capacity Heatsink]] on [[Extreme Cold]] planets adds higher effective capacity without having to wait longer to cool down.
** Heat-based weapons will continue to cool down when stowed. Used in tandem with other such weapons (like the [[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]]), Helldivers switching between them will be able to maintain constant fire without ever having to reload.
*** However, if a Helldiver is in a situation where they do have to reload, they should note that fully overheating the ICE of any heat-based weapon and letting it eject itself from the weapon first takes less time than a partial "tactical" reload. It's best to fully burn out the ICE if already committing to reloading.
** If properly managed, heat-based weapons may never run out of ammo. This makes them tactically useful in planned team loadouts, allowing squadmates to run very ammo-hungry weapons (such as the the [[FAF-14 Spear]] or [[PLAS-1 Scorcher]]). This permits them to take all ammo pickups in the mission area, as it does not negatively impact the Scythe's ammo economy.
* The Scythe is especially effective against the [[Illuminate]], as constantly fighting [[Voteless]] will not deplete ammo reserves compared other primary weapons. It is also useful for igniting [[Fleshmob|Fleshmobs]] from range, who take extra damage from fire.
* The Scythe is excellent at dealing with [[Shrieker|Shriekers]] due to its constant damage beam, making flying units easier to hit than with conventional ballistics.

{{Quote|An accurate, hard-hitting laser revolver with bespoke break action for heat sink swaps.}}The '''LAS-58 Talon''' is a [[Secondary weapon|Secondary Special]], energy-based semi-automatic laser revolver that fires pulses similarly to the [[LAS-16 Sickle]].

== Procurement ==
The Talon is unlocked on the second page of the [[Borderline Justice Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|LAS-58 TALON}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Talon's most notable traits are its accuracy, projectile speed, heat-based ammunition pool, and high damage per shot.
* Low [[Damage#Enemy_Durability_&_Durable_Damage|durable damage]] means that this sidearm struggles against {{Armor|3|AP}} armored enemies with high durability.
** Its time-to-kill against enemies like [[Stingray|light Illuminate aircraft]], [[Alpha Commander]] heads, and especially [[Annihilator Tank]] weak spots is excruciatingly slow. 
** It fares better against medium infantry like the [[Devastator]] or [[Hive Guard]], which are not affected by the Durability mechanic.
* The Talon is uniquely the only Laser weapon in the armory to be semi-automatic. Its RPM is also practically uncapped, and can fire as quickly as its relative, the [[LAS-16 Sickle]]. 
** However, its Internal Cooling Element is the smallest of any LAS weapon and ''can'' overheat within 7 shots. It is recommended to fire in short six round bursts like standard revolvers.
** It takes approximately one second for the heat of a single shot to be dissipated. This occurs even when the Talon is holstered.
** When the Internal Cooling Element is fully overheated, the Talon will automatically open up and eject the spent ICE. This allows for a slightly faster reload speed.
* Its firepower is similar to the [[R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper|Diligence CS]] and its ballistics are far superior. Despite that, the Counter-sniper is generally easier to use than the Talon at long ranges, and vice versa for close ranges.
* The [[P-113 Verdict|Verdict]] has the same level of armor penetration and deals less damage than the Talon in most situations, but the Talon will run out of reloads long before the Verdict if forced to deal maximum DPS.
* [[P-4 Senator]] enjoyers may find that the Talon cannot compete against their preferred revolver for dealing with targets with protection exceeding {{Armor|2|AP}} armor and/or high durability. Both revolvers perform similarly against most chaff enemies.
** The LAS-58's relative advantage over the Senator is that it is less punishing if not used flawlessly. It may not have {{Armor|4|AP}} armor penetration, but it can fire faster projectiles at a higher rate, and it always comes out of the holster fully loaded - as long as the heat sink isn't burned out.
* Like other [[Weapons#Secondary-0|secondary weapons]], the Talon is a One Handed weapon. A [[Helldiver]] can fire this weapon while running, and is able to use the Talon if their off hand is occupied by the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]], [[SH-51 Directional Shield|Directional Shield]], or most types of objective equipment.

== Trivia ==

* Much like its cousins, the [[Senator|P-4 Senator]],  and the [[P-11 Stim Pistol]], the Helldiver wielding the Talon can spin it around in their hands by pressing and holding the "Open Weapon Wheel" button for a few seconds.
** This also occurs occasionally when switching to the Talon from another weapon.
* The Talon appears to be based off of the iconic Colt Model 1861 Navy revolver .

The weapons ammunition capacity is only limited by heat accumulation within the weapon. == Procurement == The Dagger is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Cutting Edge Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon|LAS-7 DAGGER}}
== Tactical Information == * The weapon comes with 3 reserve heatsinks, but with good heat management, Helldivers should never run out of ammo. ** This heat sink is less effective on [[Intense Heat|hot]] planets and more effective on [[Extreme Cold|cold]] planets. It takes approximately 11 seconds to cool completely from 99% heat on hot planets, and approximately 6 seconds on cold planets. ** Heat sinks dissipate heat even when the weapon is holstered. It will only cease to do this if the heat sink is completely overheated and must be replaced. *** If a Helldiver is in a situation where they have to reload, they should note that fully overheating the ICE of any heat-based weapon and letting it eject itself from the weapon first takes less time than a partial "tactical" reload. It's best to fully burn out the ICE if already committing to reloading. * As with other [[LAS-5 Scythe|beam]] [[LAS-98 Laser Cannon|weapons]], the Dagger trades instantaneous damage for its ability to sustain damage output for long periods. ** Prolonged exposure to the beam can set targets [[Status Effects#Fire|on fire]], further boosting the damage-over-time effect. As this ignition doesn't take very long, this works well on crowds if the beam is only used on each enemy long enough to ignite them. ** This tradeoff makes it unsuitable for stopping [[Watcher|Watchers]] or [[Trooper|Troopers]] that are about to fire a flare to call reinforcements. * The One Handed trait means it can be used while holding items like the [[Retrieve Valuable Data|SSSD Hard Drive]] or the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]]. ** Being a One Handed beam weapon makes the Dagger very forgiving to fire while running. It can serve as a side-grade from the [["Guard Dog" Rover]] in this capacity, exchanging steady, autonomous targeting for an unoccupied backpack slot. * The Dagger is an excellent utility weapon to quickly remove [[Environmental Hazards]] from a considerable distance. Any contact with the beam will detonate [[Automaton Mine|Automaton]] (or [[MD-6 Anti-Personnel Minefield|Helldiver]]) mines and destroy various hazardous flora, allowing the user to sweep their crosshair across a problem area and avoid an [[Reinforce|embarrassing accident]] later. == Trivia== * Prior to patch [[1.003.104]], beam weapons such as this were capable of detonating the backpacks of Automaton [[Assault Raider|Assault Raiders]] and [[MG Raider|MG Raiders]] with the same ease that they can destroy Environmental Hazards. ** This change coincided with the introduction of heavier [[Jet Brigade]] units, and was presumably made to avoid trivializing the lighter Jet Brigade enemies. == Media == File:LAS-7 Dagger Weapon Wheel.jpg|Old Weapon Wheel (shows heat numerically) File:LAS-7 Dagger WW.png|Updated Weapon Wheel File:LAS-7 Dagger 3rd Person.jpg|Aiming, Third-Person File:LAS-7 Dagger 1st Person.jpg|Aiming, First-Person File:LAS-7 Dagger 3rd Reloads.gif|Reloading, Third-Person (overheated and partial) File:LAS-7 Dagger 1st Reloads.gif|Reloading, First-Person (overheated and partial) == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.001|changes= Change * Decreased sway modifier from 1.2 to 1 }} {{Change History Update|1.003.000|changes= Change * Sway increased from 1 to 1.2 Fix * Cancelling laser weapon reloads no longer gives them infinite ammo. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Secondary weapon|Secondary Pistol]] with a suppressor and relatively high damage for silent takedowns, especially suited to [[Stealth]] playstyles. Part of [[Obedient Democracy Support Troopers Legendary Warbond#Page 2|Helldivers 2 x Halo: ODST]] crossover.

== Procurement ==
The M6C/SOCOM Pistol is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Obedient Democracy Support Troopers Legendary Warbond#Page 3|Obedient Democracy Support Troopers]] Legendary [[Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|75}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|M6C/SOCOM PISTOL}}

== Tactical Information ==
* As a suppressed weapon, the M6C/SOCOM benefits from having a reduced detection presence compared to other weapons.
** Suppressed weapons have an audible range of 12 meters. Instead of immediately being aware of a Helldiver's position, enemies will instead become suspicious of the shots and start to investigate. Enemies still can be alerted after several rapid missed shots.
*** Helldivers can use that advantage to eliminate their targets such as [[Trooper|Troopers]] on objectives without revealing their position. Helldivers must be aware that killing any unit in patrol will still alert the rest of the group and will be engaged.
* It is recommended to target light [[Automaton]] units such as [[Trooper]]s, [[MG Raider]]s, and [[Commissar]]s first, as they are capable of calling in reinforcements.
** When targeting these units, it is recommended to aim for the head to kill them in a single shot without giving them a chance to call reinforcements.
* The M6C falls between the [[P-2 Peacemaker]] and the [[P-113 Verdict]] in terms of its combat capabilities. Its bullet trajectory is more similar to the Verdict, but it lacks  {{Armor|3|AV}} penetration. A single shot can kill most enemies smaller than a [[Warrior]] or the 'medium' variant of the [[Voteless]].
** This weapon is capable of killing a [[Devastator]] or [[Berserker]] in a single head shot, but Helldivers must be under 15 meters from their target. In combat, four rapid shots to the waist may prove more reliable than a single precision headshot from close range.

== Trivia ==
* The serial number printed on the sides of the suppressor is [https://www.halopedia.org/Halo_3:_ODST the release date of '''Halo 3: ODST'''] (September 22, 2009) followed by [https://www.halopedia.org/Battle_of_October_10 the date in the Halo timeline] on which The Covenant discovered humanity's home solar system (October 10, 2552). [https://www.halopedia.org/2552#October The events of the game] take place 10 days later.
* The [[Laser Sight W/ Flashlight|aiming laser/flashlight]] has Korean script on it. In Halo 3: ODST, this translated to "7," a number that is a running meme among Halo's developers. The text in the Helldivers rendition translates to the word "freedom".
* 'Martian Armory' is a play on the Mars-based manufacturer of this weapon in the Halo universe: [https://www.halopedia.org/Misriah_Armory Misriah Armory]. Given the condition of [[Mars]] at the time of this weapon's release, it is unclear whether these two fictional companies share a location in their respective fictions.

{{Attack_Data_Weapon|M7S SMG}}

== Attachments ==
This weapon doesn't support attachments

== Tactical Information ==
* As a suppressed weapon, the M7S benefits from having a reduced detection presence compared to other weapons.
** Suppressed weapons have reduced bullet noise. Instead of immediately being aware of a Helldiver's position, enemies will instead become suspicious of the shots and start to investigate. Enemies still can be alerted after several rapid missed shots.
*** Helldivers can use that advantage to eliminate their targets such as [[Trooper|Troopers]] on objectives without revealing their position. Helldivers must be aware that killing any unit in patrol will still alert the rest of the group and will be engaged.
* The M7S SMG shares some stats with the [[StA-11 SMG]], but has a lower fire rate in exchange for more controllable recoil.
* The M7S lacks a laser sight; it only has a flashlight. It works much like the flashlight on other weapons, being toggleable between Auto, Always-On, and Always-Off.
** Lacking a laser dot may make the M7S more difficult to use in first-person with the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield Backpack]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Assault Rifle]]. It has an attached electronics suite that provides information on rounds remaining in the magazine and compass heading.  

It is part of the Helldivers 2 x Halo: ODST crossover. 

== Procurement ==
The MA5C Assault Rifle is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Obedient Democracy Support Troopers Legendary Warbond#Page 1|Obedient Democracy Support Troopers]] Legendary [[Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|MA5C ASSAULT RIFLE}}

== Attachments ==
This weapon doesn't support attachments.

== Tactical Information ==
* The {{PAGENAME}} strikes a balance between the [[AR-23P Liberator Penetrator]] and [[BR-14 Adjudicator]] in terms of performance and is an excellent sidegrade.
** More damage than the Liberator Penetrator (65) but less than the Adjudicator (95).
** Fewer rounds in the magazine than the Liberator Penetrator (45 by default) but slightly more than the Adjudicator (30).
** More recoil than the Liberator Penetrator but less than the Adjudicator.
* Unlike other weapons, the MA5C is unique in that it has no sights at all when aiming down sights (ADS), instead keeping the third-person crosshair while aiming in first person. The weapon is held off-center, obscuring the right corner of the screen.
** While aiming in first person, MA5C's attached electronics suite displays the remaining rounds in the magazine and a compass facing due North.
** The MA5C lacks a laser sight; it only has a flashlight. It works much like the flashlight on other weapons, being toggleable between Auto, Always-On, and Always-Off.

The '''MP-98 Knight''' is a [[Weapons#Submachine Guns|Primary Submachine Gun]] with an extremely high rate of fire.

== Procurement ==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is included in the [[Super Citizen Edition]] which can be purchased for {{Tooltip|💲|USD}}20 {{Tooltip|United States dollars|USD}} or the equivalent in foreign currency.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|MP-98 KNIGHT}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Knight}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Knight is a Submachine Gun that thrives in close-quarters combat. Its extreme rate of fire and high damage-per-round exceed the performance of even the [[M-105 Stalwart]] for raw damage-per-second.
** The MP-98 Knight has the highest fire-rate of any primary weapon (tied with the [[SMG-203 Gallant]]), and the second highest RPM of any Helldiver-portable weapon in the game, surpassed only by the [[M-1000 Maxigun]].
* The Knight empties its magazines quickly. Firing in short bursts or using the alternate firing modes will help to prevent over-spraying on a dying target. Continuous full-auto is best reserved for targets with high health, durability and low armor, such as [[Fleshmob|Fleshmobs]] or the butt of a [[Charger]].
** Using the [[Siege-Ready]] [[Armor Passives|Armor Passive]] is highly recommended as it grants 2 additional magazines with the default option and 1 additional magazine with the extended option. Equipping a [[B-1 Supply Pack]] is also recommended as the weapon will chew through its ammunition reserves quickly.
** The extended magazine adds 20 rounds - less than one extra second of fully automatic fire per reload, at the cost of losing 2 reserves.
*** However, the combat load with extended magazines is 420 rounds, vs 400 rounds with standard magazines.
** Combining certain [[attachments|grips and muzzle devices]] can make the 3-round-burst mode fire incredibly tight spreads. On paper, this is competitive with the [[Diligence]]. In practice, the Knight's low-speed, high-drag bullets make this a questionable "[[Weapons#Marksman_Rifle-0|Marksman Rifle]]" to use at most ranges.
** Burst fire should also be considered against any chaff units, e.g [[Voteless]], [[Trooper|Troopers]],  and [[Scavenger|Scavengers]], as it will greatly slow ammo consumption while preserving lethality .
* Pairing the Knight with a hard-hitting [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Weapon]] such as the [[P-4 Senator]], [[P-113 Verdict]], or [[PLAS-15 Loyalist]] helps to cover for its {{Armor|2|AP}} penetration when fighting {{Armor|3|AV}} armored [[Terminids]] and [[Automatons]].
* The Knight is excellent at demolishing [[Illuminate]] energy shields. Its light penetration is much less limiting against this faction, so sidearm choice is not as important. The [[GP-31 Grenade Pistol]] and [[P-72 Crisper]] stand out for their utility in quickly destroying [[Illuminate Encampment|Squid Outposts]] and cutting off pursuing [[Voteless]], respectively.
* Like most Submachine Guns, the Knight possesses the "One Handed" trait, allowing the wielder to carry objects in the off hand while wielding the Knight in the main hand. This allows the Knight to be paired with the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|SH-20 Ballistic Shield]], or to carry important mission objects such as the [[SSSD Hard Drive]] in [[Retrieve Valuable Data]] missions or the High Value Sample found in Fortresses in the {{Difficulty|10}} difficulty.

== Trivia ==
* The design of the Knight is inspired by the [[WP:FN P90|FN P90]], both being bullpup submachine guns with a top-loading 50-round magazine, in a compact frame that ejects shells from the bottom of the gun.
* The Knight is the only weapon in-game currently that <u>must</u> be purchased.
* The Knight shares the title of the highest firerate of any primary weapon with the Gallant, at 1380 rpm. This is the second highest firerate of any Helldiver-portable weapon, losing out only to the Maxigun’s blistering 1500 rpm.

The '''P-11 Stim Pistol''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Special]] weapon that fires healing [[Stim]] rounds. 

== Procurement ==
The Stim Pistol is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Chemical Agents Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|80}}.

== Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

== Functionality ==
The Stim Pistol is a revolver with a cylinder holding 6 Stim darts. Upon hitting a teammate, it gradually restores roughly 90% of their HP over approximately four seconds. The darts' effects otherwise function identically to Stims, healing injured body parts, restoring stamina, and benefiting from the [[Experimental Infusion]] booster and both the [[Med-Kit|Med-Kit Passive]] and the [[Adreno-Defibrillator|Adreno-Defibrillator Passive]] if the weapon wielder is wearing the appropriate armor.

==Tactical Information==
* Unlike regular stims, the Stim Pistol's ammo heals Helldivers for around 90% of their HP per stim and heals them over a period of ~4 seconds rather than instantly. The stim duration can be boosted with the [[Adreno-Defibrillator|Adreno-Defibrillator Passive]] or the [[Med-Kit|Med-Kit Passive]] to provide a full heal, but its healing rate will not be boosted.
** Therefore, if a Helldiver is expecting to take near-lethal damage multiple times quickly, the stim pistol will not provide the same protection as a regular stim.
*** This can change if the patient is stimmed twice in rapid succession - the healing speed will match the speed of a regular stim. It is somewhat impractical and difficult to pull off consistently over longer ranges.
** To compensate for this, the Stim Pistol comes equipped with 30 (24+6) stims based compared to the 4 regular stims in a Helldiver's loadout, although without [[Hellpod Space Optimization]], Helldivers will spawn in with only 24 (18+6). 
** Another armor passive that pairs well with the Stim Pistol is [[Gunslinger]] for the ability to quickly draw in an emergency and spend less downtime reloading.
* The Stim Pistol only heals [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] and [[SEAF Soldier|SEAF]] units, despite the appearance of hitmarkers, with the exception of being able to detonate Automaton mines.
* The Stim darts have somewhat low projectile speed, making it difficult to hit moving teammates at range. Voice communication is advised for maximum stim efficiency.
** Good opportunities to heal teammates are right after they land from a dive or ragdoll, reloading a support weapon, operating a terminal, or manning an emplacement.
* The [[Experimental Infusion]] booster applies to the Stim Pistol's ammunition, granting team members valuable buffs in combat situations.
* [[LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle]] users benefit greatly from a teammate with the Stim Pistol as it permits them to outheal the damage received from continuous fire. It grants unrestricted use of the [[LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle|LAS-17]] and unlocks its full potential without fear of burning to death.
* As it restores and temporarily grants greatly increased stamina regeneration like a regular Stim, the Stim Pistol can be utilized to help the squad travel to distant locations faster and without delay.
* Stim Pistol darts cannot penetrate the [[SH-32 Shield Generator Pack|Shield Generator Pack]], [[G/SH-39 Shield]] or [[FX-12 Shield Generator Relay|Shield Generator Relay]]. In order to heal teammates under the effects of either, the weapon must be inside of the shield as it fires.
* Like the [[Senator]], the Stim Pistol can be reloaded with one round at a time or with a speedloader when the cylinder is empty.
* Bringing one in [[Commando Missions]] can be really helpful, since it grants a reliable source of healing for the entire team during the whole mission despite limited access to [[Resupply]] or [[Supplies#Stim Crate|Stim Crates]].

== Trivia ==
* The Stim Pistol will be spun along the Helldiver's finger when holding down the weapon wheel for a few seconds, similar to the [[P-4 Senator|Senator]] and [[LAS-58 Talon|Talon]].
** The animation is currently bugged and will only play out once. Stopping the spin will prevent the player from doing it again until they die.

The '''P-113 Verdict''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Pistol]] that inflicts high damage per round in exchange for a reduced magazine size.

== Procurement ==
The Verdict is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Polar Patriots Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|P-113 VERDICT}}

==Tactical Information==
* A high-caliber pistol, the Verdict can be considered a more powerful version of the [[P-2 Peacemaker]].
** While it has fewer rounds per magazine, each round from the Verdict deals almost 50% more damage, meaning that both weapons inflict nearly the same amount of damage per magazine. While the Verdict can make quick work of lightly armored targets, precise shooting allows the Peacemaker to win out in total damage against unarmored parts.
** The Verdict carries as many spare magazines as the Peacemaker, for a combat load of 90 rounds compared to the Peacemaker's 135 rounds. With its fewer rounds per magazine, the Verdict will find itself having to reload more often, creating more situations where the wielder may be vulnerable.
* Because of its high damage per round, the Verdict benefits greatly from targeting the weak points of enemies, for instance killing [[Devastator]]s with three shots to the abdomen or one precise headshot. In order to counteract its comparatively small magazine, hitting the weak spots of enemies can allow the Verdict to dispatch medium infantry or finish off weakened heavies with only a handful of shots.
* Because of its heavy cartridge, the Verdict is capable of penetrating {{Armor|3|AV}} armor for reduced damage. This makes it more effective at handling targets with medium armor than most other sidearms, such as [[Hive Guard]]s and [[Devastator]]s, where their rounds would simply just ricochet off.
* As it carries a large number of reserve magazines, it can be beneficial to always reload the Verdict to a full magazine between engagements, so that in the event that it is needed it will always have all rounds at the ready.
* As a Secondary Weapon, the Verdict can be wielded when the left hand is holding mission-critical equipment, or when equipped with the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield Backpack]].

== Trivia ==
* The Verdict's appearance seems to be loosely based on the [[WP:Desert Eagle|Desert Eagle]], with its "Rapid Deliberation" cartridge being a play on the Desert Eagle's [[WP:.50 Action Express|Action Express]] cartridge.
* The Verdict’s armory description claims that the weapon fires 14mm, however the projectile in-game is 12mm, similar to other pistol caliber ammunition in the game.
** This projectile is likely the exact same projectile as the [[SMG-32 Reprimand]]. This is evident by the fact that both weapons' projectiles share the exact same properties, such as stagger force and muzzle velocity. As well as the fact that balance changes to one weapon's attack always happen to the other.

== Procurement==
The Redeemer is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|5}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|P-19 REDEEMER}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Redeemer's high burst damage output makes it an ideal emergency backup weapon. It pairs well with Primary or Support weapons that cannot fend off multiple or close-ranged enemies, such as [[Weapons#Marksman_Rifle-0|Marksman Rifles]] and backpack-based [[Weapons#Support Weapons|Support Weapons]].
** It shares this niche with the [[SG-22 Bushwhacker]]. The Redeemer is far more adaptable to different situations and ranges, but the Bushwhacker can output more damage under ideal circumstances.
* The Redeemer can empty its magazine in less than two seconds. Firing short, controlled bursts is almost mandatory to avoid spending excessive ammunition on an enemy when it has already died, and also to tame the Redeemer's frantic recoil.
** The [[Armor_Passives#Gunslinger|Gunslinger]] passive armor effect drastically mitigates full-automatic recoil. It also improves the reloading speed, which, while convenient in emergencies, can lull the user into spending all their reserve ammunition in the heat of the moment.
** Setting the Redeemer to its semi-automatic fire mode mitigates both of these shortcomings, and is generally sufficient for thinning out groups of {{Armor|2|AP}} armored enemies with low HP (e.g. [[Scavenger|Scavengers]], who die in one shot).
* The [https://helldivers.wiki.gg/wiki/Equipment_Traits#One_Handed One-Handed] trait means that the Redeemer can be used while holding items like the [[Retrieve Valuable Data|SSSD Hard Drive]] or while using the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]], and it will be automatically equipped in these cases if no other weapons with One-Handed are available.
* The P-19 Redeemer has an attached flashlight, which can be set to Auto (turning on while aiming at night), always-on, or always-off. It does not have a laser pointer.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|P-2 PEACEMAKER}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Being semi-automatic and having a high fire rate, the weapon will fire as fast as you can pull the trigger. 
* It deals decent damage, able to kill most small units with a headshot. 
* The Peacemaker can be used against smaller groups of enemies, saving primary ammo for larger engagements.
* The One Handed trait means that the Peacemaker can be used while holding items like the [[Retrieve Valuable Data|SSSD Hard Drive]] or while using the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]], and it will be automatically equipped in these cases if no other weapons with One Handed are equipped.
* With the Laser Aim Module the weapon can be more easily aimed in first-person from behind a [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]] than other secondaries.
*Racking the slide is faster than [[P-19_Redeemer|P-19 Redeemer]]'s charging handle, resulting in a shorter reload time from an empty magazine (1.8s vs 2.1s). Swapping the mag alone is about equal in time (1.4 seconds).
*{{PAGENAME}} also aims a bit faster than [[P-19_Redeemer|Redeemer]], resulting in the in-game reticle following aim more closely.
* The P-2 Peacemaker has an attached flashlight and laser pointer. The flashlight can be set to Auto - turning on while aiming at night - or set to always be on or always off. The laser pointer is a green beam that makes aiming more reliable as well as displaying to other teammates where you are aiming your pistol.

It's lock-on feature ensures high accuracy, but the weapon must be reloaded after every round fired.|Armory Descripition}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Special]] single-shot weapon that fires guided missiles at targets. == Procurement == The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on Page #2 of the [[Exo Experts Premium Warbond#Page 2|Exo Experts Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|50}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon}} == Functionality == When firing, the the Missile has an extremely slow initial velocity of 1m/s which gradually acceleratess to about 50-70m/s. The Missile Pistol has two firing modes: '''Guided''' and '''Non-Guided'''. * '''Guided Mode''' disables the gun from firing unless it has locked onto a valid target. A 'valid target' is any Medium, Large, or Massive enemy. ** Maximum lock-on distance is '''100 m.''' ** The lock-on time is the same as the [[FAF-14 Spear]], which is one second. *** A fired missile will steer towards the targeted enemy. If it cannot reach its target, it will self-detonate. *** Once a lock is set, it will not acquire a different target unless the user stops aiming, breaks line-of-sight with the target, or the target is killed. *** As with all weaponry with lock-on capability, guided shots always target center mass rather than weak points. This makes it very unlikely to hit an enemy's most vulnerable area. Some [[Terminids]] are an exception to this, due to their large heads and quadrupedal posture. * '''Non-Guided Mode''' allows the user to fire the pistol freely, like any other firearm. While in ADS, the small indicator on the left side of the weapon will display the current firing mode. ** Maximum range is ~'''197 m''' == Tactical Information == * The Missile Pistol can toggle guidance modes, allowing for easy shots on fast moving targets or precise shots on enemy weakpoints. ** Aiming at the weak points of moving targets in '''Non-Guided mode''' can be tricky due to the low initial velocity of the missile. *** However, the missile does not have projectile drop like the [[EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank]], meaning that it is much easier to snipe targets at long range. * The Missile Pistol's explosion has 30 demo force, and can be used to destroy [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]], [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]], and [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]]. ** The pistol can take out an [[Automaton Fabricator]] in three shots to the outer wall of the structure, but this is a wasteful method of destroying an Automaton Fabricator. * The Missile Pistol excels against Automaton [[Gunship|Gunships]] and Illuminate [[Stingray|Stingrays]], able to lock on and take down either vehicle with a single shot. ** It is also capable of killing [[war Strider|War Striders]] in two shots * With its {{Armor|5|AP}} penetration, 1,000 100% durable impact damage, the unguided missile functions similarly to that of the [[MLS-4X Commando]]. ** Enemy weakpoints can be destroyed in a single hit, allowing for quick kills on [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]] or the rears of [[Charger|Chargers]]. *** Breakable armor can also be destroyed quickly for follow-up attacks. ** Medium targets will easily die in a single hit without being a significant waste of ammo. ** However, the missile will lose damage against targets like Automaton Fabricators or [[Factory Strider|Factory Striders]] due to matching armor penetration. * Even if a single shot does not kill an enemy, smart shot placement can weaken a fatal part enough that the enemy can be easily finished off with support weaponry like the [[APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle]] or [[MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun]]. * Be wary when using this weapon, as it is very easy to exhaust its ammo supply. Helldivers are advised to pick up supplies from a [[Resupply]] or [[B-1 Supply Pack]] to keep the weapon loaded. * The One Handed trait means that the Missile Pistol can be used while holding items like the [[SSSD Hard Drive]] or while wielding the [[Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]], and it will be automatically equipped in these cases if no other weapons with One Handed are equipped. == Media == File:P-33 Missile Pistol Weapon Wheel.png|Weapon Wheel File:P-33 Missile Pistol Weapon Aim.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:P-33 Missile Pistol Aim FPV Guided.png|Aiming, First-Person, Guided mode File:P-33 Missile Pistol Aim FPV Non-Guided.png|Aiming, First-Person, Non-Guided mode File:P-33 Missile Pistol Aim FPV Guided Locked-On.png|Aiming, First-Person, target locked File:P-33 Missile Pistol 3rd Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:P-33 Missile Pistol 1st Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person == Trivia == {{Quote|Utilizing the latest in guided, heat-propelled rounds and a lock-on feature. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Secondary weapon|Secondary Special]] pistol that fires [[Status_Effects#Gas|Gas]] darts to disorient enemies. 

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|P-35 Re-Educator}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Re-Educator benefits from having a highly reduced detection presence compared to suppressed other weapons, with a detectable radius of 1-2 meters, identical to the [[P-11 Stim Pistol]].
** It has a reduced gunshot noise, but unlike other suppressed weapons, the Re-Educator still alert enemies after a missed shot.
* The Re-Educator with its gas confusion effect is well-suited for disorienting medium-sized enemies and even some heavy enemies, opening a window for evasion or attacks with more powerful weapons.
** The Re-Educator's {{Armor|4|AP}} penetration enables it to affect enemies such as [[Hulk]]s and [[Charger]]s through their frontal armor, whereas dedicated stun weapons like the [[SG-20 Halt]] are unable to do.
*** Note that unlike stun weapons which completely incapacitate enemies for the stun duration, enemies affected by gas may continue to move or attack blindly, complicating follow-up attacks.
* With its silent deployment combined with the gas effect, the Re-Educator can prevent enemies standing at or around an encampment or point of interest from alerting their nearby allies to your presence.
** This makes the Re-Educator uniquely suited for silently taking down [[Overseer|Illuminate Overseers]] since suppressed weapons are unable to penetrate their {{Armor|3|AP}} armored heads for a quick kill.
*** With the 6 second window of opportunity the Re-Educator grants, fast-firing suppressed weapons such as the [[AR-59 Suppressor]] and [[M7S SMG]] can kill Overseers with a quick burst to their chest or legs.
** Take care not to shoot past one enemy to hit another as unlike suppressed weapons, the Re-Educator will alert enemies when shot past them.
** Unlike at encampments and points of interest, the Re-Educator will not stop enemies within a patrol from detecting the user.
* Be mindful of the Re-Educator’s '''extremely''' limited ammo reserves, as it only has 2 reserve magazines with 6 darts each, for a total combat load of 18 darts. Use of the [[B-1 Supply Pack]] is highly recommended if heavy use of the Re-Educator is expected.
* Due to the {{Armor|4|AP}} armor penetration, The Re-Educator is uniquely qualified to destroy [[Sabotage_Supply_Bases#Ammunition_Stockpile_Stats|Ammo Stockpile]]s silently.
* The Re-Educator can be used to prevent static enemies that could not normally be killed in one shot, like [[Hulk|Hulks]], from alerting nearby enemies while they are killed.

The '''P-4 Senator''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Pistol]] that can penetrate heavy armor and deals a very high amount of damage per shot.

== Procurement ==
The Senator is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|15}}.

== Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|P-4 SENATOR}}

== Tactical Information ==
* A hard-hitting revolver, the Senator possesses the 2nd highest damage per shot of all conventional sidearms in the game as well as {{Armor|4|AP}} armor penetration.
** The weapon's extreme stopping power allows it to kill any small enemy in a single shot regardless of hit location, and it can dispatch medium-sized foes with as little as one or two shots to the head.
** As a revolver, the weapon can only fire six times before it runs empty, giving it the smallest capacity of all conventional sidearms. This means good aim, and the utilization of enemy weakspots is imperative to avoid wasting ammo and time spent reloading.
** The high armor penetration means the Senator does not suffer damage reduction when penetrating {{Armor|3|AV}} armor like that used by [[Hive Guard]]s, [[Devastator]]s, or [[Overseer]]s. 
*** The Senator is the only conventional sidearm capable of dispatching all Overseer variants with one shot to the head.
* Though ineffective against most other heavy enemies due to their high health and durability, the Senator can dispatch [[Hulk]]s with '''three''' shots to the eye.
* As a revolver, the Senator reloads differently from its magazine-fed counterparts.
** When reloading the weapon with unfired rounds left in the chamber, each spent casing is removed and individually replaced. Meaning that unlike the tactical reload of magazine weapons, no unspent rounds are discarded, making the weapon perfectly ammo-efficient.
** However, this same reloading scheme also means that the more rounds are reloaded, the longer it will take. Replacing five rounds will take more time than replacing only one, though the reloading process can be interrupted in event of an emergency.
*** Partial cylinder reloads are best performed outside of combat, when there are no enemies to interrupt the long reloading process. This also takes advantage of the weapon's ammo efficiency, as unspent rounds are not wasted.
** If all six rounds are expended, a speedloader will be used to fill the entire cylinder in one motion. It is only in this situation where reloading a higher number of rounds will take less time than reloading part of the cylinder.
*** A full reload is best performed in the midst of combat, as the use of the speedloader will make the process significantly faster than individually reloading each chamber of a partial cylinder.
* Due to the slower nature of the rounds-reload mechanic and the Senator's high amount of recoil, it pairs extremely well with the [[Gunslinger]] armor passive.
* The One Handed trait means that the Senator can be used while holding items like the [[Retrieve Valuable Data|SSSD Hard Drive]] or while using the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]], and it will be automatically equipped in these cases if no other weapons with One Handed are equipped.

{{Quote|A pistol firing bursts of guided, jet-propelled ammunition. Can be set to non-guided mode at any time, removing the need to lock on to targets.|Armory Description}}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Pistol]]. It has the ability to target enemies with homing bullets whilst shooting in a three-round burst.

== Procurement ==
The P-92 Warrant can be bought from the [[Force of Law Premium Warbond|Force of Law]] page on the [[Superstore]] for {{Currency|Super Credits|300}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|P-92 WARRANT}}

== Functionality ==
* The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is unique in that it's the one of only two loadout weapons with the ability to lock onto enemies by aiming down the sights (The other being the [[P-33 Missile Pistol]]).
* The Warrant has two firing modes: '''Guided''' and '''Non-Guided'''.
** '''<u>Guided mode</u>''' 
*** Disables the gun from firing unless it has locked onto a valid target.  A 'valid target' is any Small, Medium, or Large size enemy - it cannot lock on to Massive enemies. 
*** Maximum lock-on distance is 60 meters. 
*** The lock-on time is extremely fast - approximately half a second, and almost instant for follow-up shots on targets that were near the first.
** Shots will steer towards the targeted enemy, curving in mid-air. The degree at which bullets swerve is limited, and doesn't exceed 40°~ of curvature.
** Once a lock is set, it will not acquire a different target unless the user stops aiming, breaks line-of-sight with the target, or the target is killed.
** As with all weaponry with lock-on capabilities, guided shots always target center mass rather than weak points. This makes it very unlikely to hit the most vulnerable area of an enemy. Some [[Terminids]] are an exception to this due to their large heads and quadrupedal posture.
** '''<u>Non-Guided mode</u>''' 
*** Allows the user to fire the pistol freely, like any other firearm. When switching to this mode, the optic sight flips down.

== Tactical Information ==
* Despite being a {{Armor|3|AP}} penetrating weapon, the Warrant is most efficient at clearing out smaller enemies at mid-range. This makes it exceptionally useful on low [[Difficulty]] missions. A [[Helldiver]] needs merely aim in the rough direction of their enemies. The targeting system does the rest.
* The most practical use cases for the guided mode are:
** Hitting targets that are difficult to land shots on due to their mobility, such as [[Elevated Overseer|Elevated Overseers]], [[Watcher|Watchers]], [[Obtruder|Obtruders]], [[Shrieker|Shriekers]] etc.
** Targeting units surrounding fellow helldivers without risking friendly fire.
** Targeting units in low visibility conditions, such as on planets with a lot of dust or fog, at night, or while in [[Blizzards]] / [[Sandstorms]]. 
*** Even when not directly aiding in combat, the lock-on can serve as a niche scouting tool, detecting enemies that otherwise may be difficult to spot. Notably, it can lock-on to [[Stalker|Stalkers]] even while they're invisible.
**The guided mode will target the pilots of [[Veracitor|Veracitors]] and [[Gatekeeper|Gatekeepers]], allowing one to dispatch them when their cockpit shield is depleted.
* Guided mode can be a hindrance in some other cases:
** The lock-on circle on the HUD can indicate a lock on an enemy that is near the edge of the circle at any range. In close quarters, this is too far off-target for the guidance system to compensate for. The wielder will have to both aim manually ''and'' have a valid lock on in order to score a hit in this situation.
** The guided mode is also not infallible at extended ranges. Targets that are moving laterally may still require leading in order for projectiles to hit. Approaching, retreating, and stationary enemies are most likely to be hit.
** Enemies behind partial cover may not be exposed enough for the targeting system to lock on to them. Ranged enemies in this scenario can attack with impunity unless the weapon is on unguided mode.
*** [[Heavy Devastator|Heavy Devastators]] are worth particular mention in this context. They can occupy a target lock in addition to being very difficult to angle guided shots around their shield.
** Guided mode's requirement that the weapon be sighted makes it impossible to fire the weapon without slowing to a walking pace. Against [[Berserker|Berserkers]] and other resilient, aggressive enemies, it may be wiser to switch to unguided mode and fire while running.

== Trivia ==
* The Warrant is the second firearm obtainable from the Superstore, the first being the limited time crossover exclusive [[StA-52 Assault Rifle]].
* The Warrant along with its [[BP-77_Grand_Juror|related superstore items]] appear to reference [[wikipedia:Judge_Dredd|Judge Dredd]] from the ''2000 AD'' comics, with the Warrant specifically resembling Dredd's signature "Lawgiver" pistol. It differs from its source material in that it does not have the ability to switch between multiple exotic ammunition types on demand.
* The Warrant's armory description describing jet propelled ammunition exists in real life via the now discontinued [[wikipedia:Gyrojet|Gyrojet]], a unique family of firearms designed to fire specialized mini-rockets called "Microjets." Unlike its real life parallel however, the Warrant appears to have recoil and a system for guiding its rounds towards targets.

Avoid standing in proximity to the blast.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Primary weapon|Primary Energy-Based]] weapon that fires explosive energy projectiles. == Procurement == The Scorcher is unlocked on the 10th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|75}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|PLAS-1 SCORCHER}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Scorcher}} == Tactical Information == * The explosive bolts can damage groups of tightly packed enemies, along with any Helldiver standing too close to the blast. * Without the [[Hellpod Space Optimization]] [[Boosters|Booster]], it comes with 3 out of 5 possible magazines. The [[Siege-Ready]] [[armor Passives|Armor Passive]] slightly alleviates Scorcher's ammo economy with +1 magazine. * The Scorcher's traits make it viable against nearly every enemy in the game. The exploding plasma can bypass medium armor present on enemies like [[Hive Guard|Hive Guards]], [[Scout Strider|Scout Striders]], and [[Devastator|Devastators]]. The blasts are also highly effective against the durable butts of [[Charger|Chargers]], [[Impaler]] faces, the vents on [[Automatons|Automaton]] [[Hulk|Hulks]], and [[Tank|Tanks]]. ** Note that while the explosion can penetrate {{Armor|3|AP}} armor, the plasma projectile only has {{Armor|2|AP}} armor penetration. Careful aim against armored enemies is still important to make full use of every shot. * The Scorcher is capable of eliminating [[Gunship|Gunships]] by shooting at the thrusters because the explosions are {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetrating. * [[Hunter|Hunters]] and [[Pouncer|Pouncers]] may frequently complicate the use of this weapon, as they can quickly get into melee range of the shooter and render the Scorcher unsafe to fire. However meleeing and quickly backstepping to shoot is a good tactic to avoid self-damage. * It has the lowest amount of stagger out of any explosive weapon; all enemies fragile enough to be meaningfully staggered by the explosion's inner radius will be killed outright anyway. == Media == File:PLAS-1 Scorcher Weapon Options .png|Weapon Wheel File:PLAS-1 Scorcher ADS.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:PLAS-1 Scorcher First-Person.png|Aiming, First-Person File:PLAS-1_Scorcher_3rd_Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:PLAS-1_Scorcher_1st_Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.004.100|changes= Change * Plasma projectiles will now pass through foliage without losing velocity }} {{Change History Update|1.003.000|changes= Undocumented change * Adjusted the reloading animation and sound-effects and the HUD-elements to properly match the reloading timings. Charging up a shot fully makes the bolt explode on impact.|Armory Description}} The '''PLAS-101 Purifier''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapon|Primary Energy-Based]] weapon that can fire variable-charge bolts of gas. == Procurement == The Purifier is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Polar Patriots Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|80}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack Data Weapon|PLAS-101 PURIFIER}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Purifier}} == Tactical Information == * The Purifier fires a plasma projectile that inflicts impact damage as well as a small explosion. If the trigger is held down, the power of the projectile is greatly increased. ** Fully charging the Purifier for one second increases the initial velocity and impact damage of the projectile, as well as increasing the explosion's damage, radius, push force, and stagger force. *** The power of a shot does not benefit from a partial charge, only increasing in power upon reaching full charge. ** During the charging process, Helldivers are greatly slowed. Releasing the trigger or switching to a different weapon will immediately fire the weapon. * Because of the different properties of its charged & uncharged projectiles, the Purifier can be effective in a variety of situations. ** Uncharged shots can be fired rapidly, granting immediate damage output in hectic combat situations, at the cost of low damage and explosion radius. This makes it effective against small enemies in close range where it is not practical to fully charge a shot. *** However, this is very ammo-inefficient and should be done sparingly. ** Charged shots inflict a very high amount of damage as well as staggering enemies, at the cost of a slower rate-of-fire and movement speed. This makes it effective against medium-sized enemies, as well as interrupting enemy attacks and stagger-locking certain enemies. * The Purifier is best used when engaging enemies at medium range, between roughly 10-50 meters. This is for two reasons: ** Like most other plasma weapons, the Purifier suffers from a significant drag factor of 150%, meaning that it has significant damage falloff at range, as well as the fact that the initial velocity is roughly half of most ballistic weaponry. ** Firing charged shots at very close range can be dangerous, as the explosion will inflict a significant amount of self-damage. *** It is better to fire uncharged shots at targets if they are within melee range, or switch to a reliable [[Weapons#Secondary-0|Secondary Weapon]]. * With a capacity of 15 and 6 spare mags, the Purifier can fire 75 shots before running out of ammo. ** This can be alleviated by equipping armor with the {{Passive|Siege-Ready}} passive, adding two spare magazines. ** Like other plasma weapons, the Purifier does not benefit from tactical reloads. Because of this, every round should be fired before reloading, as to not waste what limited ammunition the Purifier has. * Like other plasma weapons, the Purifier's explosions have very low [[Demolition|demo force]], and are incapable of destroying fences or enemy spawners. == Trivia == * Contrary to the weapon's armory description, the bolt will explode whether or not the weapon is charged ** This is also the case for every plasma weapon in Helldivers 2 == Known Issues == *[[[1.001.104]]] The Purifier's minimum charge time is incorrectly set at 0.01s, instead of the stated 0.1s. This results in a much higher firing rate than expected. *The explosion appears to be larger based on the distance from the impact to the shooter. This is a visual bug and does not represent the actual explosion size. == Media == File:Purifier Fire Rate Bug.mp4|Purifier's bugged rate of fire as of patch 1.001.104 File:PLAS-101_Purifier_WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:PLAS-101_Purifier_3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:PLAS-101_Purifier_1st.png|Aiming, First-Person File:PLAS-101_Purifier_3rd_Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:PLAS-101_Purifier_1st_Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person ==Change History== {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.001.201|changes= Undocumented Change * Updated Armory description }} {{Change History Update|1.001.104|changes= Changes * Projectiles can now be charged up with a damage multiplier that scales. ** Minimum charge of 0.1 sec gives a 50% damage multiplier. ** Maximum charge of 1 sec gives a 100% damage multiplier. * Maximum charge projectile damage increased from 100 to 200. * Maximum charge projectile durable damage increased from 50 to 100. * Maximum charge explosion damage increased from 150 to 300. * The explosion doesn’t scale, but a fully charged shot has a different explosion effect: ** Minimum charge (0.1–0.99 sec): Inner radius 1m, outer radius 2m, explosion damage 75 ** Maximum charge (1 sec): Inner radius 2.9m, outer radius 3m, explosion damage 300 Undocumented Change * Mass reduced from 100g to 25g * Drag factor increased from 100% to 150% }} {{Change History Update|1.000.400|changes= Changes * Increased projectile armor penetration from {{Armor|2|AP}} to {{Armor|3|AP}}. * Decreased explosion damage falloff. }} {{Change History Update|1.000.303|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} [[Category:Weapons|1]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Energy-Based]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__

Plasma projectiles explode on impact.|Armory Description}} The '''PLAS-15 Loyalist''' is a [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Special]] pistol that fires explosive plasma projectiles. == Procurement == The Loyalist is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Truth Enforcers Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|45}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|PLAS-15 LOYALIST}} ==Tactical Information== * Functioning effectively as a sidearm equivalent of the [[PLAS-101 Purifier]], the Loyalist is distinguished from it by its lower damage and much lower ammo capacity. ** Like the Purifier, the Loyalist can either be charged up to fire highly damaging and moderately large plasma explosions, or tap-fired in a pinch to rapidly deliver lower-damage bolts. ** Unlike the Purifier, the Loyalist's direct plasma bolt penetrates only Light armor when uncharged. ** Due to its innate splash damage even on un-charged shots, the Loyalist proves to be a poor emergency self-defense weapon. However, it is a powerful tool for bombarding enemies at medium range. ** It's especially risky to use the Loyalist's fully charged blasts against aggressive enemies that manage to catch a Helldiver off-guard, such as [[Hunter|Hunters]], [[Pouncer|Pouncers]], and especially [[Stalker|Stalkers]], since the explosion can cause self damage when fired at close range combatants. * The explosion from a fully-charged shot will stagger and greatly push back enemies as large as [[Brood Commander|Brood Commanders]] and [[Scout Strider|Scout Striders]]. Use this to maintain distance and safely follow up with more blasts. * Both the charged bolt and accompanying explosion deal high amounts of damage to durable enemy parts, even relative to many primary weapons. This is especially useful against [[Charger]] butts and [[Tank]] vents. * Because the Loyalist is a one-handed weapon, shots can be charged from the hip while maintaining full walking speed. * One notable quirk with the Loyalist's Third Person aim mode is that the reticle isn't an accurate representation of where the pistol will shoot; the actual shot will stray slightly to the left in actuality. This can be nullified by using First Person aiming. * The Loyalist's high stagger/push force, and low-ish damage makes it an ideal weapon for flipping a rolled [[FRV]] without popping the tires. == Media == File:PLAS-15 Loyalist Weapon Wheel.jpg|Weapon Wheel Icon File:PLAS-15 Loyalist 3rd Person.jpg|Aiming, Third-Person File:PLAS-15 Loyalist 1st Person.jpg|Aiming, First-Person File:Truth Enforcers Premium Warbond Marketing.jpg|Marketing Image File:PLAS-15 Loyalist 3rd Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:PLAS-15 Loyalist 1st Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person ==Change History== {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.100|changes= Changes * Increased magazine capacity from 7 to 8 * Shorter charger-up time on full charge up from 1 sec to 0.75 sec }} {{Change History Update|1.006.001|changes= Change * Decreased sway modifier from 1.2 to 1 }} {{Change History Update|1.003.000|changes= Changes * Decreased spread from 25 to 10 * Sway increased from 1 to 1.2 }} {{Change History Update|1.002.101|changes= Changes * Starting magazines increased from 2 to 3 * Spare magazines increased from 4 to 5 }} {{Change History Update|1.001.201|date=2024-10-31|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} [[Category:Weapons|2]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Special Secondaries]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__

It is part of the [[Helldivers 2 x Killzone Legendary Warbond]] or the [[Helldivers x Killzone]] crossover package. ==Acquisition== The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Righteous Revenants Legendary Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|50}}. Previously, it was given as a free log-in reward for the [[Helldivers x Killzone]] collaboration as of December 19, 2024. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack Data Weapon|PLAS-39 ACCELERATOR RIFLE}} == Attachments == This weapon doesn't support attachments. == Tactical Information == * The {{PAGENAME}} is characterized by its incredible long-range power but low magazine and ammo capacity. ** Combined, the three shots of a burst deal immense damage. This is enough to put down any medium-sized target with one burst, provided the user can land their shots. *** Note that one burst to the torso is ''not'' quite enough to kill an undamaged [[Devastator]] if all three shots hit the armored chest. To kill in one burst, at least one round must strike the unarmored head or abdomen. As such, it is advised to aim for the gut against these targets. *** In addition to its power against medium-sized enemies, the PLAS-39 shines at rapidly defeating heavier ones such as [[Hulk|Hulks]] or [[Charger|Chargers]] by targeting their weak points. This is also the case against emplaced enemies such as [[Bunker Turret|Bunker Turrets]]. ** The PLAS-39's muzzle velocity is extremely high, exceeding any ballistic-based weapon, and has a nearly non-existent drag factor. *** This means that the PLAS-39's projectile damage fall-off is minimal at long range. * The PLAS-39's Achilles' heel is its combination of low magazine capacity and lack of semi-auto fire mode. Only three bolt bursts can be fired before the magazine is emptied. Reloading the PLAS-39 occurs frequently, which is a liability when facing close-range targets. ** The [[Siege-Ready]] armor passive is a match made in heaven for the PLAS-39. In addition to providing extra ammo, it greatly improves the reload time of the PLAS-39, which means more time can be spent shooting targets. *Although most plasma weapons are effective against crowds, the PLAS-39 fares poorly due to its small area-of-effect and tiny magazine capacity. == Media == File:PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle 3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle 1st 50m.png|Ditto, First-Person (50 Meters) File:PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle 1st 100m.png|First-Person (100 Meters) File:PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle 1st 200m.png|First-Person (200 Meters) File:PLAS-39_Accelerator_Rifle_3rd_Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:PLAS-39_Accelerator_Rifle_1st_Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person == Trivia == * The PLAS-39 is based off of the [https://killzone.fandom.com/wiki/VC39_Accelerator_Rifle VC39 Accelerator Rifle] from Killzone. Like the [[StA-X3 W.A.S.P. Launcher]], it wasn't featured in ''Killzone 2'', in this case instead being from the PS Vita spinoff ''Killzone: Mercenary''. * The PLAS-39 was previously categorized as a Sniper Rifle in the loadout menu, the first and only loadout weapon to hold such a distinction. The weapon was moved to the Energy category in patch [[1.003.000]], which withdrew the Sniper Rifle category from view. ==Change History== {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.004.100|changes= Changes * Extra spare magazines increased from 8 to 12 * Ergonomics increased from 40 to 60 }} {{Change History Update|1.003.000|changes= Changes * Drag decreased from 150% to 10% * Is now categorized as an energy weapon in the loadout menu }} {{Change History Update|1.002.003|date=2024-12-19|changes= Addition * Added to the game and presented as a holiday gift.[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/553850/view/516322672418750491 HELLDIVERS™ 2 | Steam][https://blog.playstation.com/2025/12/11/the-helldivers-2-x-killzone-items-return-as-a-legendary-warbond-dec-18/ Mitchell Ayre | PlayStation Blog][https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/553850/view/491584577841661619 HELLDIVERS™ 2 | Steam]}} ==References== [[Category:Weapons|1]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Energy-Based]] [[Category:Killzone]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__
