Can be set to fire in three shot bursts, to easily conduct the Fallen Hero's Salute.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Marksman_Rifle-0|Primary Marksman Rifle]] that can fire in semi-automatic or three-round bursts modes. It is affixed with a bayonet, improving melee damage and range. ==Acquisition== The {{PAGENAME}} can be obtained on the 1st page of the [[Masters of Ceremony Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon|R-2 AMENDMENT}} {{Attack_Data/attack|damage|Melee_Bayonet}}
== Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Amendment}} == Tactical Information == * The Amendment is a versatile marksman rifle, able to hit enemies from afar with its semi-auto mode or deal massive damage up close with its burst mode. ** Helldivers with a particularly good trigger finger can effectively utilize the Amendment like an [[Weapons#Assault_Rifle-0|assault rifle]] due to its high potential DPS. * Much like the [[AR-61 Tenderizer]], it deals very high damage per round, but only possesses {{Armor|2|AP}} armor penetration, making it far less effective against heavier enemies. ** Due to this weakness, a [[Weapons#Secondary-0|secondary weapon]] with better armor-piercing capabilities such as the [[P-113 Verdict]] or the [[LAS-58 Talon]] is highly recommended. *** If there is no other option, the attached bayonet of the Amendment penetrates {{Armor|3|AP}} armor. == Media == File:R-2 Amendment WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:R-2 Amendment 3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:R-2 Amendment 1st.png|Ditto, First-Person File:R-2 Amendment Bayonet.png|Bayonet in Action File:R-2 Amendment 3rd Reloads.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:R-2 Amendment 1st Reloads.gif|Reloading, First-Person == Trivia == * When reloading the Amendment in first-person, there is a [https://www.reddit.com/r/Helldivers/comments/1knha1h/the_amendment_has_a_hasty_weld_on_the_magwell/ large welding job visible on the magwell]. This is noticeable compared to other weapons, where the weldings are much smaller, and more refined. * The name of the R-2 Amendment likely refers to it being another ceremonial rifle like the [[R-2124 Constitution]], as well as referring to the [[wp:Second Amendment to the United States Constitution|Second Amendment to the United States Constitution]]. * The appearance of the Amendment seems to be loosely based on the American [[wikipedia:M14_rifle|M14 Rifle]]. ** This also could be the source of the line "conducting the Fallen Hero's Salute," as the M14 is still used in the U.S. as a ceremonial weapon, notably for [[wikipedia:Tomb_of_the_Unknown_Soldier_(Arlington_National_Cemetery)#/media/File:Snowy_vigil_(51041134956).jpg|soldiers guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier]] as well as performing the [[wp:Three-volley salute|Three-volley salute]]. ==Change History== {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.300|changes= Fix * The R-2 Amendment reload now continues correctly if interrupted - if reload is interrupted early, it will not lose magazines. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.001|changes= Changes * Increased Bayonet melee damage from 110 to 165 * Increased Bayonet melee durable damage from 55 to 83 }} {{Change History Update|1.003.200|changes= Change * Bayonet stagger strength increased from 20 to 25. R-2124 Constitution.wikitext:
{{Tabs | name1 = Helldivers 2 | link1 = R-2124 Constitution | name2 = Helldivers 1 | link2 = Helldivers 1:M2016 Constitution }} {{Last Updated|1.007.000}} {{Infobox Weapon |title = {{PAGENAME}} |image = R-2124 Constitution Primary Render.png |damage = {{Damage|Ballistic|180}} |penetration = {{Armor|3|AP}} |capacity = 5 |recoil = 15 |fire_rate = 60 rpm |dps = 180 |source = [[Liberty Day]] |rounds_reload_first = 0.95s |rounds_reload_rest = 0.3s |reload_time = 1.3s |spare_rounds= 100 |firing_modes = Bolt-Action |weapon_traits = Medium Armor Penetrating {{*}} Rounds Reload |weapon_category = Primary Weapons |weapon_type= Marksman Rifles |supply_box_refill = 100 |ammo_box_refill = 50 }} {{Quote|This ceremonial rifle is modeled after antique relics from pre-Democratic times. It is traditionally gifted to every citizen upon turning 16 to encourage service.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a bolt-action [[Weapons#Marksman_Rifle-0|Primary Marksman Rifle]] reminiscent of pre-Democratic rifles. It is affixed with a bayonet, improving melee damage and range. ==Acquisition== Distributed to all present and future [[Helldiver]]s as of October 27, 2024, along with the [[DP-00 Tactical]] [[Armor#Medium-1|armor]], to celebrate [[Liberty Day]]. == Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon|R-2124 CONSTITUTION}} {{Attack Data/attack|damage|Melee_Bayonet}}
== Attachments == The Constitution does not have any attachments. == Tactical Information == * The Constitution is commonly considered a "challenge weapon" by the community due to its lackluster performance and in-game status as a "ceremonial" firearm. ** The Constitution has the lowest damage-per-second value out of all [[Weapons#Primary-0|primary weapons]]. This is largely because of its very slow fire rate, at just 60 rounds-per-minute. ** In addition to its low damage output, the Constitution's 5 round capacity is among the smallest of the primary weapons. Reloads are frequent and relatively long, depending on how much of the magazine is expended. ** However, when the magazine is completely expended, the Helldiver will insert a stripper clip containing 5 bullets, drastically decreasing the length of the reload. In most situations it is probably best to expend the entire magazine, instead of undergoing the potentially lengthy process of partially reloading it. ** The Constitution cannot be customized with [[attachments]]; this prevents the use of more powerful optic sights than the basic irons included with the weapon. *Despite its shortcomings, the Constitution is not without redeeming qualities. ** Its rounds can damage {{Armor|3|AP}} armor, allowing it to engage a wide variety of enemies. ** The Constitution has a generous ammo reserve, capable of holding 100 extra rounds, 120 if the [[Siege-Ready]] armor passive is equipped. ** As each round is reloaded individually, no ammo is wasted when reloading. ** The attached bayonet penetrates {{Armor|3|AP}} armor similar to the rifle, and it gives the Constitution greater melee damage than weapons without a bayonet. Using the [[Peak Physique]] or [[Reinforced Epaulettes]] armor passives increase melee damage even further. *** Attacking with the bayonet is also completely silent, which can prevent nearby enemies from being alerted to one's position. *The Constitution demands great skill and accuracy to be used effectively, and even then it still underperforms compared to most weapons due to its inferior stats in nearly every category. **It fares poorly against the [[Terminids]] and [[Illuminate]]. These factions attack in hordes that are far too large for the Constitution to handle, even considering its bayonet. **On the contrary, the Constitution's precision, armor-piercing rounds, and damage can make it a viable weapon for the [[Automatons]]; many of their infantry units can be eliminated with a well-placed shot while also spawning in smaller numbers than the former two factions. ***These traits, however, are also possessed by the [[R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper]], which shares armor penetration values, deals slightly more damage, has triple the magazine size, a faster reload, and access to scopes. The [[R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper]] only sacrifices 10 rounds in overall capacity, the shell-loading feature, and the bayonet which would typically see much less use against Automatons. * When using the Constitution on high-difficulty missions, Helldivers are advised to use it more like a secondary weapon option in conjunction with {{Armor|2|AP}} armor penetrating, fast firing weapons like the [[M-105 Stalwart]], [[P-19 Redeemer]] or [[P-92 Warrant]], using the automatic weapons to deal with crowds and using the Constitution for long-distance targets, melee kills, and {{Armor|3|AP}} armored enemies. == Media == File:R-2124 Constitution WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:R-2124 Constitution 3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:R-2124 Constitution 1st.png|Ditto, First-Person File:R-2124 Constitution Bayonet Stab.png|Bayonet in Action File:R-2124 Constitution 3rd Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person (per round, before 1.007.000) File:R-2124 Constitution 1st Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person (per round, before 1.007.000) File:R-2124_Constitution_3rd_Reload_Fast.gif|Reloading, Third-Person (full) File:R-2124_Constitution_1st_Reload_Fast.gif|Reloading, Third-Person (full) == Trivia == * The Constitution closely resembles World War I rifles, specifically the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M1903_Springfield M1903 Springfield] and the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M1917%20Enfield M1917 Enfield]. * The Constitution has a tactical reload animation that is more easily seen in first-person, where the Helldiver holds down the rounds in the internal magazine to prevent them from ejecting. == Known Issues == '''[[1.001.104]]''' * Tapping backwards during the bayonet stab animation will cause the Helldiver to freeze their stab animation; this does not negatively affect any control over the Helldiver. Not recommended for close-quarters use.|Armory Description}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Explosive]] weapon that fires jet-assisted shells which explode into shrapnel on impact. == Procurement == The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Democratic Detonation Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|R-36 ERUPTOR}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Eruptor}} ==Tactical Information == * The Eruptor excels at delivering devastating damage with each shot but suffers from a very low fire rate and limited ammo capacity. ** The weapon’s bolt must be manually cycled after each shot, making it the slowest-firing primary weapon in the game. ** With a five round magazine and six spare magazines, the Eruptor has a total ammo capacity of only 35 rounds. *** This can be alleviated by equipping armor with the [[Siege-Ready]] passive, increasing spare magazines and reload speed. *** Tactical reloads are most effective when only one round is left in the weapon, as this ensures that no ammo is wasted, as well as increasing reload speed. Due to the Eruptor's limited ammo capacity, every shot is very valuable, and leaving excess rounds in the discarded magazine is wasteful. * Having a base value of 25, the Eruptor has the lowest ergonomics value of all primary weapons (tied with the [[VG-70 Variable]]), meaning that it is slower to move the weapon around while aiming. ** This can be alleviated by wearing armor with the [[Peak Physique]] passive, which adds +30 ergonomics value to all weapons. *** Additionally, equipping the Eruptor with [[Iron Sight]]s and an [[Angled Foregrip]] can alleviate its poor ergonomics by increasing its practical ergonomics value from 21 to 35. * The jet-assisted rounds of Eruptor are highly versatile, capable of dealing both high single-target and area damage, while having no damage falloff. ** Medium/Large enemies will take damage from the projectile impact, explosion, and shrapnel all at once. This combined damage can eliminate most medium-sized enemies in one or two shots. *** Shrapnel makes the Eruptor especially useful against certain unarmored [[Illuminate]] targets, such as [[Fleshmob]]s [[Crusher]]s, and energy shields used by [[Harvester]]s. ** Groups of small enemies can be quickly killed, as they are damaged by both the explosion and shrapnel. *** This is especially effective against [[Terminids]], allowing a single shot to wipe out entire patrols of [[Pouncer]]s, [[Bile Spitter]]s, or even [[Bile Spewer]]s (via chain reaction). * The [[Demolition|Demo Force]] of the Eruptor's explosion makes it effective against enemy spawners and certain [[Missions#Tactical Objectives|mission objectives]]. A single round can destroy a [[Bug Hole]], [[Automaton Fabricator]]s, and [[Grounded Warp Ship]]s by hitting their weak spots ** Certain optional objectives such as [[Terminate Illegal Broadcast|Illegal Broadcast Towers]]. [[Spore Spewer]]s, and [[Shrieker Nest]]s can be destroyed in very few shots. * The Eruptor performs best at long ranges by utilizing its jet rounds and standard [[10x Sniper Scope]]. Helldivers are advised to engage targets at a distance, as the poor ergonomics, fire rate, and danger of shrapnel make the Eruptor a hazard in close-quarters. ** The Eruptor's rounds have a one-second lifetime with a maximum range of 185 meters, after which rounds will automatically explode. * Because of the explosion and shrapnel dealt at the point of impact, Helldivers can easily kill themselves on accident by shooting targets that are too close. This same care should be extended to allies as well. * A reliable Secondary or rapid-fire Support Weapon is recommended to deal with enemies at close range. Pistols like the [[P-113 Verdict]] and [[LAS-58 Talon]] can quickly dispatch individual targets, while Support Weapons like the [[MG-43 Machine Gun]] or [[M-105 Stalwart]] are effective options for several close-range enemies. ** Drone backpacks like the [[AX/AR-23 Guard Dog]] or [[AX/LAS-5 Rover]] can also be useful, killing most small enemies before they can get too close. ==Trivia== * The Eruptor appears to be based on the prototype [[wikipedia:Barrett_XM109|Barrett XM109]] OSW (Objective Sniper Weapon), also known as the AMPR (Anti-Materiel Payload Rifle). ** This was a [[wikipedia:Barrett_M82|Barrett M82]] converted to fire [[wikipedia:25_mm_grenade|25x59mm]] grenades out to a range of 2,000 meters. * The description for the YouTube video documenting the changes that occur in [[1.003.000|Patch 01.003.000]] erroneously lists the Eruptor as the "R-32 Eruptor" as opposed to correct designation of {{PAGENAME}}.https://youtu.be/Cca-KKScFKc?si=5ulVONEQseoAxEQU == Fires armor-piercing rounds coated in a high-ignition thermite compound to ignite targets.|Armory Description}} The '''R-4 Hyena''' is a [[Weapons#Marksman Rifle-0|Primary Marksman Rifle]] similar to the [[R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper]], trading magazine count, fire rate, and handling for greater firepower and incendiary rounds. == Procurement == The R-4 Hyena was awarded to all Helldivers who have participated in any stage of [[Campaigns#Celestial Fence|Campaign Celestial Fence]] on 13th July, 2026. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|R-4 Hyena}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|HYENA}} == Tactical Information == * Compared to the [[R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper]], the Hyena has slightly higher standard damage along with incendiary ammunition, but suffers from much greater vertical recoil, slightly worse ammo economy, and slower fire rate . Like other marksman rifles, the Hyena is able to deliver high-damage, precise shots from long range, killing most light-medium enemies with a single well-placed shot. ** Most light enemies such as [[Scavenger]]s, [[Trooper]]s, and [[Voteless]] will almost always all die in a single shot, anywhere on the body. The fire damage that follows will finish them off in the rare cases that they manage to survive the shot. ** Medium enemies such as [[Devastator]]s and [[Warrior]]s can be killed with one headshot. *** Note that it is ammo inefficient to bodyshot mediums to ignite them as they have high ignition thresholds. ** The Hyena benefits against enemies that are primarily made up of {{Armor|2|av}} armor, as its {{Armor|3|ap}} armor-penetrating rounds will deal full damage, rather than the reduced 65% of matching penetration. * With 15 rounds and a maximum of 5 spare mags, the Hyena only comes with 90 rounds before running empty. Helldivers are advised to practice proper accuracy and target prioritization in order to maximize each round. Short mags offer +10 overall rounds carried alongside better ergonomics and reload time. * At close range, the Hyena's limited magazine size, poor ergonomics of 21, and it’s comparatively slow fire rate become a problem when dealing with large groups of enemies. Close range, fast firing secondary weapons such as the [[P-19 Redeemer]] and [[LAS-58 Talon]] can complement this weakness effectively. == Trivia == * The appearance of the Hyena seems to be based on the Romanian [[wikipedia:PSL_(rifle)|PSL]], a developmental offshoot of the Soviet [[wikipedia:SVD_(rifle)|SVD]], or “Dragunov”, a designated-marksman rifle issued as a squad support weapon. ** In terms of the round fired, the Hyena fires a 9x70mm round, similar to the 9.3x64mm round fired by the [[wikipedia:SVDK|SVDK]], a modernized special-purpose variant of the SVD. * The Hyena bears a strong resemblance to the [[Helldivers 1:LHO-63 Camper|LHO-63 Camper]] marksman rifle from the First Galactic War. * Interestingly, the icon used for the Hyena in the Weapon Wheel and the player HUD appears to use the short magazines, not the extended ones available by default. == Media == File:R-4 Hyena WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:R-4 Hyena 3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:R-4 Hyena 1st 50m.png|Ditto, First-Person (50 Meters) File:R-4 Hyena 1st 100m.png|First-Person (100 Meters) File:R-4 Hyena 1st 200m.png|First-Person (200 Meters) File:Hyena Promotional Image.png|Promotional Preview File:R-4 Hyena 3rd Reloads.gif|Reloading, Third-Person (full and partial) File:R-4 Hyena 1st Reloads.gif|Reloading, First-Person (full and partial) == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.301|date=2026-07-13|changes= Addition * Added to Helldiver Arsenals. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.300|date=2026-06-30|changes= Announced[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s5xxT-LWRYY HELLDIVERS™ 2 Campaign Brief: Termicide 2.0] }} == Known Issues == * R-4 Hyena may lose mags if interrupted during the reload animation == References == [[Category:Weapons|1]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Marksman Rifles]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__

The '''R-63 Diligence''' is a [[Weapons#Marksman_Rifle-0|Primary Marksman Rifle]] that fires {{Armor|2|AP}} armor penetrating, but highly damaging shots.

== Procurement ==
It is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|8}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data_Weapon|R-63 DILIGENCE}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Diligence}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Due to the nature of this weapon, it is most suitable for taking out {{Armor|0|AP}} and {{Armor|1|AP}} enemies from medium to long range, and rewards accuracy.
* Compared to its heavier sibling, the [[R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper]], the standard Diligence fires projectiles with reduced damage and {{Armor|2|AP}} armor penetration in exchange for better ergonomics, lighter recoil, and more ammunition. These traits make the weapon more responsive in short-range combat, give it an edge against groups of light enemies, but further emphasize the need for accuracy when facing {{Armor|3|AP}} armored enemies since it can only hit and damage their weak points.
** The Diligence can be difficult to use against the [[Terminids]] due to their numbers and increased armor and health at higher difficulties, particularly for the heads.
** The Diligence finds a niche in dispatching infantry [[Automatons]] with precise single shots at range or from cover.
*** [[Devastator]]s and [[Berserker]]s can notably be killed in a single headshot, aided by the Diligence's relatively high ergonomics on par with most assault rifles.

== Known Issues ==
*The weapon's barrel is partially rendered while aiming in first person. This can only be seen when the weapon is sighted for 25 meters.

The '''R-63CS Diligence Counter Sniper''' is a [[Weapons#Marksman Rifle-0|Primary Marksman Rifle]] similar to the [[R-63 Diligence]], trading magazine size and handling for greater firepower that can damage {{Armor|3|AP}} armor.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 7th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|R-63CS DILIGENCE COUNTER SNIPER}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Diligence Counter Sniper}}

== Tactical Information ==

* The R-63CS is the archetypal marksman's rifle of the armory, capable of dealing with targets well out of ranges where they can retaliate. This is especially useful against the [[Automatons]] due to its high accuracy and {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetration (which also deals full damage against {{Armor|2|AP}} armor.)
** [[Trooper|Troopers]] and their subtypes will all die in a single shot, unless they are hit in the arm.
** [[Devastator|Devastators]] can be killed with one headshot, though unlike the standard [[R-63 Diligence]], the R-63CS can also penetrate the {{Armor|3|AP}} armor on the rest of their body while dealing full damage to any {{Armor|2|AP}} armored sections. This is most effective when targeting the waist or legs, where three shots will prove fatal.
** [[Scout Strider|Scout Striders]] and their [[Reinforced Scout Strider|Reinforced variant]] can be killed with three shots to the waist or joint, or four to a leg. They may also be instantly killed with one shot to their side mounted missiles.
** For [[Gunship|Gunships]], nine shots to one thruster is enough to bring them down.
* At close range, the R-63CS's limited magazine size and poor ergonomics become a problem for large groups of enemies. Close range secondary weapons such as the [[P-19 Redeemer]] and [[LAS-58 Talon]] can complement this weakness effectively.
** With the introduction of custom [[attachments]], it is possible to negate these shortcomings by converting the R-63CS into a potent close-to-mid range weapon. This however requires switching out its powerful scope, and the weapon's limited magazine cannot be upgraded.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Marksman Rifle-0|Primary Marksman Rifle]] equipped with a suppressor for silent takedowns, specially suited for [[Stealth]] playstyles. 

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}. 

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|R-72 Censor}}

==Attachments Table==
{{Attachments Table|Censor}}

== Tactical Information ==
* As a suppressed weapon, the Censor benefits from having a reduced detection presence compared to other weapons.
** Suppressed weapons have an audible range of 12 meters. Instead of immediately being aware of a Helldiver's position, enemies will instead become suspicious of the shots and start to investigate. Enemies still can be alerted after several rapid missed shots.
* Helldivers can use that advantage to eliminate their targets, such as [[Trooper|Troopers]], on objectives without revealing their position. However, killing any unit in patrol will still alert the rest of the group and will be engaged.
* Helldivers are recommended to target light [[Automaton]] units such as Troopers, [[MG Raider]]s, and [[Commissar]]s first, as they are capable of calling in reinforcements.
** When targeting these units, it is recommended to aim for the head or legs to kill them in a single shot without giving them a chance to call reinforcements.
*The Censor is very similar to the [[R-63 Diligence]], boasting the same damage values and armor penetration. However, there are some key differences that make it a sidegrade.
**The Censor has slightly higher stagger force than the Diligence, allowing it to stagger larger chaff such as [[Warrior|Warriors]], [[Hive Guard|Hive Guards]], and [[Devastator|Devastators]].
**The Diligence has a higher base magazine capacity at 25.
**The Diligence has significantly higher bullet velocity. This can make long-range shots much easier to land.

Produced by ST Construction.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Energy-Based-0|Primary Energy-Based Marksman Rifle]] that fires high-damaging bolts of energy, capable of cleaving through enemies. == Procurement == The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Castellan’s Creed Legendary Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle}} == Attachments == This weapon does not support attachments. == Tactical Information == * The Hot-Shot is capable of cleaving through low-armored enemies such as [[Voteless]], potentially leading to multiple kills with a single shot. * While categorized as an energy-based weapon, the Hot-Shot acts as a marksman rifle, trading rate-of-fire for increased per-shot damage. * The Hot-Shot deals the second-highest damage of all marksman rifles (behind only the [[Deadeye]]) and has low recoil, but is limited by its relatively small ammo capacity of 12 shots. ** Unlike most laser weapons, the Hot-Shot has a limited magazine that does not recharge. Rather it behaves like plasma-based energy weapons, requiring its power cell to be reloaded and not benefiting from tactical reloads. ** This poor ammo economy can be alleviated by equipping armor with the [[Siege-Ready]] passive, increasing its maximum magazine count as well as reload speed. * The Hot-Shot has low ergonomics compared to other marksman rifles, making it harder to handle against enemies in close quarters or when widely spread out. ** This can be alleviated by equipping armor with the [[Peak Physique]] or [[True Grit]] passive. == Media == File:R40-K_Hot-Shot_Marksman_Rifle_WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:R40-K_Hot-Shot_Marksman_Rifle_3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:R40-K_Hot-Shot_Marksman_Rifle_1st_50m.png|Ditto, First-Person (50 Meters) File:R40-K_Hot-Shot_Marksman_Rifle_1st_100m.png|Ditto, First-Person (100 Meters) File:R40-K_Hot-Shot_Marksman_Rifle_1st_200m.png|Ditto, First-Person (200 Meters) File:R40-K_Hot-Shot_Marksman_Rifle_3rd_Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:R40-K_Hot-Shot_Marksman_Rifle_1st_Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person == Trivia == * The R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle is based on the [[lexicanum:Hot-Shot_Lasgun#Cadian-pattern_Hot-shot_Lasgun|Cadian-Pattern Hotshot Lasgun]]. Like the name suggests this iteration comes in a [[lexicanum:Hotshot_Marksman_Rifle|marksman configuration]]. * The producer of this weapon is ST Construction, referencing the Warhammer 40,000 [[lexicanum:Standard_Template_Construct|Standard Template Constructs]]. It can switch between {{Armor|3|AP}}-armor penetrating flechettes and {{Armor|2|AP}}-armor penetrating stun pellets. == Procurement == The SG-20 Halt is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Truth Enforcers Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|SG-20 HALT}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Halt}} == Tactical Information == * The '''{{PAGENAME}}''''s magazine tubes are independent from each other. Swapping the tubes by using the Weapon Wheel can help avoid a reload in dire situations. ** Due to this, Helldivers are advised to ensure both tubes are loaded before engaging in combat. ** Shells share the same reserve ammo pool. Helldivers should prioritize what shells they immediately need if they're low on ammo. * Stun rounds can be used to effectively stall enemies when you need to reload your flechette tube. ** Using stun rounds on decapitated charging [[Brood Commander|Brood]]/[[Alpha Commander|Alpha Commanders]] is a good tactic to completely halt their berserk charge, providing time to switch to a [[Support Weapon]] to finish them off or to retreat. ** Using stun rounds on any form of [[Overseer]] will give you plenty of time to switch to the [[P-4 Senator]], [[APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle]], or even [[RS-422 Railgun]] and line up a shot at their head, killing them instantly. At close range, the Halt's own flechette shells can achieve the same effect if enough flechettes hit the head directly. *The Halt has significant spread which is slightly better than the [[SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary]]. Therefore, it is ill-advised to engage enemies at medium range as most of your pellets will not hit your target. *The Halt benefits greatly from being able to swiftly switch between its flechette and stun firing modes. For PC players, it is advisable to set an accessible keybind to "Quick Weapon Wheel: Left" to easily swap between the weapon's two modes without needing to engage the weapon wheel every time a different mode is needed. ==See Also== List of Punisher-style weapons: * [[SG-8 Punisher]] * [[SG-8S Slugger]] * [[SG-451 Cookout]] * [[SG-8P Punisher Plasma]] * '''{{PAGENAME}}''' ==Media== File:SG-20 Halt WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:SG-20 Halt 3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:SG-20 Halt 1st Flechettes.png|First-Person (Flechettes) File:SG-20 Halt 1st Stun.png|First-Person (Stun) File:SG-20 Halt Load Chamber.png|Loading Stun Rounds File:SG-20 Halt Flechette Tube.png|Loading Flechette Rounds File:SG-20 Halt Rifling.png|The Rifled Barrel of the SG-20 Halt File:Halt Stun FX.gif|Stun Ammunition Visual Effects File:SG-20_Halt_3rd_Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:SG-20_Halt_1st_Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person == Trivia == * Both the [[SG-8S Slugger]] and '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are the only shotguns to feature rifled barrels for better projectile velocity and accuracy. However, the Halt does not fire any slug rounds, making its rifling redundant. ** In real life, rifling is actually ''detrimental'' to shotguns that are not firing slugs - as rifling is known to cause a pattern akin to a donut. While the in-game shotgun does not have such a pattern, its lower overall accuracy could be due to the fact it has a rifled barrel. * The appearance of the SG-20, like all Punisher variants, is loosely based on the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTAS_UTS-15 UTS-15.] == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.001|changes= Change * Move the “ammo type” weapon function from Right to Left weapon function direction }} {{Change History Update|1.002.101|changes= Fixes * Fixed a crash that could occur when reloading the SG-20 Halt }} {{Change History Update|1.001.201|date=2024-10-31|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} [[Category:Weapons|1]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Shotguns]] {{Nav Weapon}} __FORCETOC__

The '''SG-22 Bushwhacker''' is [[Weapons#Secondary Weapons|Secondary Special]] triple-barreled shotgun.

== Procurement ==
The Bushwhacker is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Viper Commandos Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|50}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|SG-22 BUSHWHACKER}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Bushwhacker is a one-handed shotgun that offers two distinct firing modes. The first mode fires each barrel individually, while the second mode fires all three barrels of 10-Gauge Buckshot simultaneously. Its unique design and versatile firing capabilities make this weapon well-suited for close-quarters combat situations.
* Like the [[P-4 Senator]] or [[SG-8 Punisher]], the Bushwhacker reloads one shell at a time. No shells are discarded during the reload, but each expended shell makes the reload progressively longer.
** Pairing this coach gun with the [[Armor_Passives#Gunslinger|Gunslinger]] armor effect shortens reload times to the point where the Bushwhacker is capable of sustained single-barrel fire if reloaded immediately after every shot.
** Volley-fire mode expends all chambers at once for a massive burst of damage. The full reload that follows means users should save this for {{Armor|2|AP}} armored targets with large health pools. 
*** The [[Alpha Commander]] and [[Fleshmob]] are prime examples of valid targets. Using this fire mode on a chaff enemy - while potentially hilarious - is a waste of ammunition.
* The Bushwhacker is a suitable Secondary weapon for Helldivers seeking close-range burst damage and stagger. The Bushwhacker has enough stagger force to keep even [[Stalker|Stalkers]] at bay.
* The One Handed trait means that the Bushwhacker can be used while holding the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|Ballistic Shield]] or [[SH-51 Directional Shield|Directional Shield]]. Its stagger force and damage output make it a solid choice for aggressive Shield users.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a fully-automatic, mag-fed [[Primary Weapon|Primary Shotgun]] that is able to dish out tremendous amounts of damage in a short period of time. 

== Procurement ==
It is unlocked on the 4th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for 20 [[Medals]]

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|SG-225 BREAKER}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Breaker}}

== Tactical Information ==
* As a fully automatic shotgun, the Breaker is excellent at providing very high damage against large groups of [[Factions|Enemies]] at close range. 
* The Breaker is extremely effective against large groups of lightly armored enemies, such as [[Voteless]], [[Trooper]]s and chaff [[Terminids]] like [[Scavenger|Scavengers]] and [[Hunter|Hunters]].
* The Breaker's excellent damage is offset by its poor ammo economy. Careful firing is recommended to avoid running out of ammunition earlier than anticipated. 
* Being a shotgun, the Breaker's main weakness is its spread, making it less effective at range than other [[Weapons#Primary-0|Primary Weapons]].
* Compared to the [[SG-8 Punisher]], the Breaker has much less stagger force, meaning that enemies will not be slowed or staggered after being hit, which can be problematic against fast-moving enemies such as  [[Alpha Commander]]s and [[Stalker|Stalkers]].
* Compared to other Breaker variants, the SG-225 breaker is suitable for focusing down single targets at slightly longer ranges than its counterparts due to its relatively tight spread. It further benefits from fitting the [[Half Choke]] and [[Full Choke]] muzzle attachments in this role.

Generates heat during use, so limited to burst fire.|Armory Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a burst fire [[weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Shotgun]], a variant of the standard [[SG-225 Breaker|Breaker]] that fires incendiary buckshot. == Procurement == The SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}. It can also sometimes be found at [[Minor Places of Interest]] on lower difficulty. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|SG-225IE BREAKER INCENDIARY}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Breaker Incendiary}} == Tactical Information == * Relative to [[SG-225 Breaker|the weapon it is derived from]], the Breaker Incendiary trades standard damage and pellet velocity for more [[Damage#Enemy_Durability_&_Durable_Damage|durable damage]] and [[Status Effects#Fire|burning damage]] over time. This makes up for its lower pellet damage in many situations. ** The burn effect is useful in engaging in hit and run strategies or quickly switching targets. This is most effective against chaff enemies, such as [[Warrior|Warriors]]. Be aware that enemies are still capable of acting in the time that they are on fire and may briefly continue to be a threat. * The Breaker Incendiary is very good at dealing with hordes and setting multiple enemies on fire due to its large spread. ** It is recommended to use the [[Duckbill]] muzzle attachment because it reduces vertical spread by 70% and increases horizontal spread by 60%. This helps to keep pellets from flying over a target's head or falling short while still allowing pellets to hit adjacent enemies. * The Breaker Incendiary has similar damage per shot to the [[SG-225SP Breaker Spray&Pray]], but is able to set enemies on fire for additional damage. The Breaker Incendiary has a '''much''' lower reserve of spare magazines to compensate for this. ** Tradeoffs between DoT or more instances of direct damage vary in importance depending on the specific enemy targeted. Prior to [[1.003.000#Fire_and_Flamethrowers|version 1.003]], burning was equally effective against all enemies. {{Quote|A  modified [[SG-225 Breaker|breaker shotgun]] firing birdshot, small pellets which saturate and area to clear up smaller targets.|Armory Description}}

The '''SG-225SP Breaker Spray&Pray''' is a fully-automatic [[Primary Weapon|Primary Shotgun]], a variant of the standard [[SG-225 Breaker|Breaker]] that fires a wide and mostly horizontal spread of birdshot pellets. 

== Procurement ==
The Breaker Spray&Pray is unlocked on the 9th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|SG-225SP BREAKER SPRAY&PRAY}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Breaker Spray&Pray}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The weapon is equipped with a "[[Duckbill]]" muzzle device and [[Drum Magazine]] by default.
* The wide spray of the weapon allows it to be an effective weapon at clearing crowds of small and lightly armored enemies at close range. Loadouts should be planned around its deficiencies in dealing with anything larger than a [[Brood Commander]] in a single magazine.
** Its ballistics and damage per shot are second best to the [[SG-225 Breaker]]. Compared to the S&P, its parent weapon is more specialized towards targeting individual enemies and has a marginally longer effective range.
* The Breaker S&P has similar damage per shot to the [[SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary]], but is unable to set enemies [[Status Effects#Fire|on fire]] for additional damage. The S&P has a '''much''' larger reserve of spare magazines to compensate for this.
** Tradeoffs between DoT or more instances of direct damage vary in importance depending on the specific enemy targeted. Prior to [[1.003.000#Fire_and_Flamethrowers|version 1.003]], burning was equally effective against all enemies. This is no longer the case.
** Spray&Pray's slightly higher rate of fire and generous supplies encourage use of the weapon according to its name: by firing long bursts indiscriminately. 
*** This characteristic gives the Spray&Pray good synergy with the [[Siege-Ready]] passive armor effect.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Energy-Based]] weapon, a variant of the standard [[SG-8 Punisher|Punisher]] that fires {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetrating, exploding plasma rounds. 

== Procurement ==
The Punisher Plasma is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Cutting Edge Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|SG-8p PUNISHER PLASMA}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Punisher Plasma}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The Punisher Plasma acts like a high-arcing grenade launcher converted [[PLAS-1 Scorcher]]. Unlike most explosive weapons, its projectile does zero damage, instead using a proximity fuse that detonates on enemies or structures.
** Because of this, the Punisher Plasma is excellent at horde clearing lower-health enemies like [[Trooper]]s and [[Warrior]]s.
* Be wary of firing at point blank range, as the plasma explosion is very likely to kill nearby Helldivers. 
** Using armor passives that reduces explosive damage like [[Armor Passives|Fortified]] can mitigate this. 
** Helldivers are advised to run an effective sidearm, such as a [[LAS-58 Talon]] or [[P-113 Verdict]] to deal with enemies that get too close.
* Due to the Punisher Plasma's very high stagger value, it can effectively stun large groups of [[Devastator|Devastators]], [[Berserker|Berserkers]], or [[Scout Strider|Scout Striders]] from range. Staggering such a group with 1-2 shots, even if it doesn't kill, this can save a teammates life.
* Like other explosive weapons, the Plasma Punisher excels against the [[Jet Brigade]], easily detonating their signature jetpacks.

This means the shotgun acts more like a rifle, firing a single projectile per shot. ==Procurement== The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 8th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}. == Detailed Weapon Statistics == {{Attack_Data_Weapon|SG-8S SLUGGER}} == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Slugger}} == Tactical Information == * The slugger has {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetration and is able to pierce [[Hive Guard]] heads, [[Bile Spewer]]s, and [[Devastator]] torso armor. * Despite description, the slugger doesn't boast outstanding durable damage. *The Slugger can hold 16 shells in its magazine and carries up to 60 reserve shells, for a total combat load of 76 shells. *An Ammo box restores 30 reserve shells, and a [[Resupply]] box restores 60. *Unlike most other weapons, the {{PAGENAME}} reloads one shell at a time, rather than reloading by magazine. This has advantages and disadvantages: **It takes 6.4 seconds to reload the entire 16 shell magazine. ** Reloading can safely be done at any point, as there is no danger of wasting ammo by throwing away a partially filled magazine. **The reloading process may be interrupted at any time without losing any progress by firing the shotgun, switching weapons, diving, or interacting with any item. It will be ready to fire as long as it has 1 shell loaded. **Reloading any time the gun isn't being shot with will ensure that Helldivers will never run the tube empty **When reloading with exactly 8 rounds in the magazine, the final round count will increase by one round, making it 17 rounds. Moreover, every subsequent reload performed with 8 or more rounds remaining will result in a final count of 17 rounds, until the number of rounds in the magazine drops below 8. *The Slugger's slugs cause stagger. Which can be helpful for aggressive and fast enemies like [[Berserker|Berserkers]] and [[Stalker|Stalkers]]. *Due to its {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetration and high damage, it is excellent at dispatching up to a medium amount of low to medium threats. *Because of its low rate of fire, it is recommended to bring alternative weapons that can handle crowds of smaller enemies, like the [[MG-43 Machine Gun]] or [[AX/AR-23 "Guard Dog"]]. Though with good accuracy, it's still a somewhat decent horde-clearer. *While the First Person View, also known as ADS (Aim Down Sights), is useful for long range precision shots, the third person view is recommended for close range encounters due to the superior handling. Be mindful that the slug fired by the shotgun has a lot of drag, so more rounds will be required to put down a target at range. *Shots can penetrate through a single light-armored body part, allowing for multiple kills with one shot to be possible. ==Media== File:SG-8S Slugger WW.png|Weapon Wheel File:SG-8S Slugger 3rd.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:SG-8S Slugger 1st.png|Ditto, First-Person File:SG-85 Slugger Rifling.png|The Rifled Barrel of the SG-8S Slugger File:SG-8S Slugger ADS First-Person.png|Previous Reticle Design File:SG-8S Slugger 3rd Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:SG-8S Slugger 1st Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person ==Trivia== * The {{PAGENAME}} has a unique reloading animation, where the Helldiver can be seen loading shells into the magazine from the left- and right-side bandoleers attached to the shotgun. == Attachments == {{Attachments Table|Sweeper}} == Tactical Information == * The Sweeper boasts increased damage, pellet count, 46% tighter spread, and a bayonet compared to the [[SG-20 Halt]]. In exchange, it can not fire stun pellets and has a slightly smaller magazine for flechettes. * Compared to other pump-action shotguns, the Sweeper has much lower stagger force, meaning that enemies will not be as slowed or staggered after being hit, which can be problematic in close quarters. * Uniquely, the Sweeper can "slamfire," meaning that Helldivers can hold down the trigger to automatically operate the pump and fire the weapon at the same time, almost doubling its effective rate of fire compared to the SG-20 Halt. ** This is functionally no different from regular full-auto fire. * As a Rounds Reload weapon, the Sweeper is reloaded one shell at a time. This prevents wasted ammo upon reload. As a trade-off, a complete reload from empty will be slower than that of a traditional magazine. Helldivers are advised to reload frequently and ensure the magazine is always full. ** Helldivers can continuously fire by pressing Reload after each shot. This is made even easier to execute with the [[Siege-Ready|Siege Ready]] armor passive. * The Sweeper comes equipped with a bayonet, which can provide useful damage and stagger at point-blank range, as well as providing an attack option while out of ammo. == Media == File:SG-97_Weapon_Wheel.png|Weapon Wheel File:SG-97_Aiming,_Third-Person.png|Aiming, Third-Person File:SG-97_Aiming,_First-Person.png|Sweeper, First-Person File:SG-97_Sweeper_3rd_Reload.gif|Reloading, Third-Person File:SG-97_Sweeper_1st_Reload.gif|Reloading, First-Person File:SG-97_Sweeper_No_Reserve.png|Zero reserve shells remaining == Trivia == * The appearance of the Sweeper seems to be loosely based on the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winchester_Model_1897 Winchester Model 1897], a shotgun famous for its use in World War 1 by United States forces. ** Specifically, the Sweeper is based on the "Trench Gun" variant of the 1897, fitted with a shortened barrel, heat shield, and bayonet. ** The Sweeper also shares its real-life counterpart’s ability to “slamfire”, where the trigger is held down, and the pump is operated continuously to rapidly fire off shells. ** Additionally, the Sweeper shares the designation of "SG-97" and reports claim that U.S. troops referred to the 1897 as the "trench-sweeper." * As with many weapons in the game with modeled ammunition reserves on the gun, the 4 shells attached to the gun disappear when loading the last 4 shells carried by the Helldiver. *When selected in the Weaponry tab, the Sweeper will play an animation of a shell being loaded into it before it gets cocked. == Known Issues == *[[[1.006.100|1.006.100]]] Audio bug when firing one shot; it can often sound like two shots were fired. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.300|changes= Fix * SG-97 Sweeper should now reliably eject shells when slamfiring. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.100|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} {{Nav Weapon}} [[Category:Weapons|1]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Shotguns]] __FORCETOC__

The '''SMG-203 Gallant''' is a variant of the [[MP-98 Knight]] that sacrifices damage in exchange for {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetration.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on Page #1 of the [[Exo Experts Premium Warbond#Page 1|Exo Experts Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Gallant}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Compared to the MP-98 Knight, the Gallant has lower damage output, but is equipped with {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetration. This makes it more effective against enemies such as [[Devastator|Devastators]], [[Overseer|Overseers]], and [[Bile Spewer|Bile Spewers]].
* The Gallant empties its magazines quickly. Firing in short bursts or using the alternate firing modes will help to prevent overspraying on a dying target. Continuous full-auto is best reserved for targets with high health, durability and low armor, such as [[Fleshmob|Fleshmobs]], [[Impaler]] faces, or the butt of a [[Charger]].
** Using the [[Siege-Ready]] [[Armor Passives|Armor Passive]] is highly recommended as it can make up for the otherwise poor ammo economy. Along with this, the [[B-1 Supply Pack]] can help sustain the Gallant's ammo count.
* Like most Submachine Guns, the Gallant possesses the "One Handed" trait, allowing the wielder to carry objects in the off hand while wielding the Gallant in the main hand. This allows the Gallant to be paired with the [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|SH-20 Ballistic Shield]], or to carry important mission objects such as the [[SSSD Hard Drive]] in [[Retrieve Valuable Data]] missions or the High Value Sample found in Fortresses in the {{Difficulty|10}} difficulty.
* The Gallant also has a slightly better muzzle velocity compared to the [[MP-98 Knight|Knight]] (450m/s vs 375m/s) making it marginally better at hitting targets at range.

== Trivia ==
* Like the [[MP-98 Knight|MP-98]] Knight, the design of the Gallant is inspired by the [[WP:FN P90|FN P90]], being bullpup submachine guns with a top-loading magazine in a compact frame that ejects shells from the bottom of the gun.
* Interestingly, despite the Gallant being based off of the Knight, it does not share the Knight’s unique designation of “MP”, for Machine Pistol.

The '''SMG-32 Reprimand''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Submachine Gun]] with high damage and {{Armor|3|AP}} armor penetration in exchange for restricted magazine size.

== Procurement ==
The Reprimand is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Truth Enforcers Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|SMG-32 REPRIMAND}}

== Attachments ==

{{Attachments Table|Reprimand}}

== Tactical Information ==
* With a high caliber round and short barrel, the Reprimand excels at engaging armored enemies at close range.
** The main defining characteristic of the Reprimand is that it fires {{Armor|3|AP}} Armor penetrating rounds that inflict significant amounts of damage per shot. In exchange for higher recoil, less ergonomics, smaller capacity magazines and a longer empty reload time.
** Like the [[SMG-37 Defender]], the Reprimand has a low rate of fire, which limits its ability to quickly put lead on target. As such, it is better to try to make every shot count, taking advantage of each individual round's high stopping power.
* The Reprimand can benefit from a variety of [[Armor Passives]].
** [[Engineering Kit]] or [[Fortified]] can reduce weapon recoil by 30%, which can help keep the weapon under control when firing at full auto.
** [[Peak Physique]] can improve the weapon's handling, as its ergonomics are the weakest among Submachine Guns, being more comparable to that of Assault Rifles.
** [[Siege-Ready]] and [[Reinforced Epaulettes]] improve reload speed, which disproportionately benefits the Reprimand due to its slow reload time.
*** Siege-ready also provides 2 additional spare magazines to help counteract its small magazine size and constant reloading.
* One major disadvantage of the Reprimand is that unlike all other Submachine Guns in the game, it is incapable of being one-handed. This means that it cannot be utilized with Stratagems like the [[SH-51 Directional Shield|Directional Shield]] nor carry important mission equipment like the [[SSSD Delivery|SSSD]] or the High Value Sample in {{Difficulty|10}}.

== Trivia ==
* The Reprimand appears to be visually based on the [[wp:Heckler & Koch UMP|H&K UMP45]], including the famous "HK Slap" when performing an empty reload.
* The Reprimand likely fires the exact same projectile as the [[P-113 Verdict]]. This is evident by the fact that both weapons' projectiles share the exact same properties, such as stagger force and muzzle velocity. As well as the fact that balance changes to one weapon's attack always happen to the other.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Submachine Gun]] that fires concussive rounds that can stun enemies.

== Procurement ==
The Pummeler is unlocked on the 2nd page of the [[Polar Patriots Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|60}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|SMG-72 PUMMELER}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Pummeler}}

==Tactical Information==
* The SMG-72 Pummeler has reduced damage and rate of fire compared to the [[SMG-37 Defender]], but fires specialized ammunition that can [[Status_Effects#Stun|stun]] enemies.
** Compared to the [[AR-23C Liberator Concussive]] and [[AR-32 Pacifier]], the SMG-72 Pummeler has the highest damage per shot out of the three "crowd-control" [[Weapons#Primary-0|primary weapons]].
** Despite having a higher damage value, given its nature as a submachine gun, it also suffers from the same significant drag factor which sharply diminishes its damage over distance, making it primarily effective at closer ranges within 35 meters.
* The SMG-72 Pummeler shares the same [[Status_Effects#Stun|stun]] effect as the AR-32 Pacifier, capable of incapacitating enemies for three seconds. 
** Generally, the size of the target is proportional to their resistance to stun effects with smaller targets requiring only one or two shots to be interrupted whereas larger targets such as [[Charger|Chargers]] require sustained fire in order to remain stunned.
*** Large enemies such as [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]] and emplacements such as [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]] cannot be stunned.
** The stun effect can be reapplied multiple times on the same target, which will refresh the duration of the stun, but it will not extend its duration.
* Stunning enemies provides a significant advantage in combat, allowing Helldivers to quickly halt any enemy actions and attacks, and leaving enemies open to gunfire.
** Stun effects are highly effective against [[Terminids]] and [[Watcher|Watchers]] as it can interrupt their ability to call for reinforcements.
*** This is especially useful against [[Brood Commander|Brood Commanders]] and [[Alpha Commander|Alpha Commanders]] where decapitation is often not fatal, as they can still summon [[Warrior]]s despite missing their heads.
*** Stuns are also useful in controlling multiple enemies by dispersing shots on different targets, providing temporary relief for other Helldivers.
*** The Pummeler is effective against Illuminate due to the lack of medium armor on their non-heavy units. However, since Fleshmobs are resistant to being staggered, it is recommended to use higher-damage Support Weapons to kill them.
* In addition to the stun effect, the SMG-72 Pummeler also has a higher stagger value than most SMGs, enough to interrupt an attacking [[Hunter]] mid-pounce.
* As a submachine gun, the SMG-72 Pummeler is also capable of being one-handed, allowing it to be used with [[SH-20 Ballistic Shield Backpack|ballistic]] or [[SH-51 Directional Shield|energy shields]], or carrying items such as the [[SSSD Hard Drive|SSSD Hard Drives]].
** Helldivers can also fire the weapon without aiming and can fire behind them, making it ideal for closing the distance on enemies or creating distance against pursuing enemies. However, accuracy is severely impacted while doing so.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Primary Weapon|Primary Submachine Gun]] with an extremely high rate of fire. It is part of the [[Helldivers 2 x Killzone Legendary Warbond]] or the [[Helldivers x Killzone]] crossover package.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Righteous Revenants Legendary Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|65}}. Previously, it was given away for free for all players who logged in during the second phase of the Helldivers x Killzone crossover event.

== Weapon Statistics==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon}}

== Attachments ==
This weapon doesn't support attachments.

== Tactical Information ==
* The StA-11 is an extremely rapid-fire SMG, most comparable to the [[MP-98 Knight]]; it has less recoil, a lower fire rate, slightly lower capacity, and identical damage (previously higher). Like most weapons in its class it trades accuracy and lethality at range for close-range combat potential, whilst the position of its large helical magazine precludes the installation of underbarrel [[attachments]] like flashlights. Its lower recoil and fire rate means it's much more stable than the Knight and doesn't climb quite as aggressively.
* As a crossover weapon, the StA-11 SMG cannot be customized in any way using the attachments system.

== Known Issues ==
* When the reload process is interrupted, resuming the reload will immediately consume a magazine, even if the reload has not been completed. This can occur each time the reload process is interrupted, which can result in multiple magazines being lost without the weapon being readied to fire.

== Trivia ==
* The StA-11 is based on the [[fandom:killzone:StA-11_Submachine_Gun|StA-11 Submachine Gun]] from ''Killzone 2''.
* The StA-11 appears to be a mashup of the the [[wp:PP-19 Bizon|PP-19 "Bizon"]] and [[wp:IMI Uzi|IMI Uzi]] SMGs, having a Bizon-style skeletal stock and the distinctive helical magazine, with the more rectangular chassis, longer barrel, and top-mounted charging handle of the Uzi. Its capacity is much lower than the PP-19 at just 48 rounds compared to the PP-19's 53 to 64 round magazines (depending on exact caliber).

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Assault Rifle]] with a drum magazine. It is part of the [[Helldivers 2 x Killzone Legendary Warbond]] or the [[Helldivers x Killzone]] crossover package.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Righteous Revenants Legendary Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}. Previously, it was available to be unlocked in the [[Superstore]] for {{Currency|SC|615}} throughout the duration of the [[Helldivers x Killzone#First version|original crossover]].

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon|StA-52 ASSAULT RIFLE}}

== Attachments ==
This weapon doesn't support attachments.

==Tactical Information==
* The StA-52 strikes a balance between the [[AR-23 Liberator]] and [[AR-23A Liberator Carbine]] in terms of performance, but has a higher magazine capacity than either of them do by default, thanks to its larger drum magazines. It is still very accurate and controllable despite having higher recoil and a faster rate of fire than the basic Liberator, and it can easily dispatch groups of softer opponents when fired using short, controlled bursts.
** Despite having higher magazine capacity, the StA-52 has only six spare magazines (eight with [[Siege-Ready]]) means it has very slightly less ''total'' ammunition than either the Liberator or the Carbine.
* Due to only having {{Armor|2|AP}} AP, the StA-52 does well when paired with [[Weapons#Secondary-0|secondary]] and [[Weapons#Support_Weapons|support weapons]] that have {{Armor|3|AP}} or {{Armor|4|AP}} AP.
* Unlike the standard Liberator, the StA-52 lacks a laser sight; it only has a flashlight. It works just like the flashlight on other weapons, being toggleable between Auto, Always-On, and Always-Off.
* The StA-52's basic iron sights make it harder to use at longer ranges, especially as it has no adjustments for distance unlike the standard Liberator. It also can't be switched into Burst mode, only having Semi and Auto modes.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Primary Weapons|Primary Special]] weapon. It is a seven-barrelled volley gun with three different firing modes: Auto, Volley, and Total, as well as variable rpm options.

== Procurement ==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Control Group Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|VG-70 VARIABLE}}

== Attachments ==
{{Attachments Table|Variable}}

== Functionality ==
The VG-70 Variable, as its name suggests, is a weapon system with variable firing modes and rpm options.
* '''Auto:''' Fully-automatic with three available rpm options; 300, 550 & 750.
* '''Volley:''' Fires one round from each barrel simultaneously, totaling 7 rounds on target with one trigger pull.
** This firing mode is semi-automatic, but is affected by the selected rpm. Produces significant recoil.
* '''Total:''' Fires all remaining ammunition in the magazine.
** Using this mode will deal 15 damage to the [[Helldiver]]'s right arm and ragdoll them if not prone and when firing more than 22 rounds at once.
** This mode has the added usecase of acting as a mini jump pack if the Helldiver dives while firing towards the floor. This is most useful for getting up some small ledges or over city walls when already on an elevated position (such as a garbage bin).

==Tactical Information ==
* The Variable, as implied, comes with 3 fire modes.
** '''Auto:''' Fully-automatic, like a standard assault rifle, with 85 normal damage per shot.
*** Recommended for infantry or fodder.
** '''Volley:''' Fires one round from each barrel simultaneously. 595 damage (85 x 7). It deals 161 damage to 100% durable enemy parts.
*** Recommended for tough medium enemies (eg. [[Alpha Commander]] heads, [[Bile Spewer]] mouths, [[Devastator]] stomachs or [[Berserker]] stomachs).
*** This firing mode suffers from high recoil. This can be mitigated by aiming down sights, crouching, going prone, and using armors that reduce recoil, such as [[Fortified]] and [[Engineering Kit]].
** '''Total:''' Fires all remaining loaded ammunition from all barrels. Maxes out at 4,165 damage (85*49) when fully loaded. On 100% durable enemy parts the maximum durable damage of TOTAL mode is 1,127 damage.
*** Recommended for the weak spots of heavy enemies, like [[Hulk]] vents, [[Charger]] butts, [[Impaler]] heads, [[Fleshmob]] heads or [[Harvester]] eye sockets.
*** Firing while leaning out of the [[M-102 Fast Reconnaissance Vehicle|FRV]]'s doors will not ragdoll Helldivers, but will still deal damage.
*** Diving backwards and firing or using a jump pack and firing backwards midair in this mode enables players to "jump" much greater distances thanks to the recoil, useful when a quick escape or a large gap must be crossed. With skill, jumps can be made in excess of 50 meters, though significant damage may be incurred.
* The Variable's projectiles have much higher drag than other assault rifles, resulting in a noticeable decrease in damage per bullet over longer ranges. This is slightly compensated by the Variable's firing modes that fire more bullets at a time.
* The Variable suffers from very low ergonomics. Armor passives like [[True Grit]] and [[Peak Physique]] can help mitigate this.

== Trivia ==
* The Variable's seven-barrelled configuration resembles the 18th century [[wp:Nock gun|Nock gun]], a flintlock muzzleloader.
* The Variable's functionality appears inspired by the "Bertha" prototype volley gun developed by [[wp:Metal Storm|Metal Storm]], which electronically fires projectiles superposed inside each of its barrels. Like the Variable, Bertha could adjust its rate of fire, even to the point where it could fire all of its ammunition in a fraction of a second.
